tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)dpal pad+ma dkar po'i rdo rje'i glu'i 'phreng ba snga ma bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)༄༅// rgyal ba thams cad kyi gong bu dpal 'brug pa yab sras la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i ut+pal rgyas pa'i snying*// 'jam mgon ral gri zhugs pa'i dpal gyi gzi// 'khor ba'i mun pa gzhom la nyin byed lta'i// ngo mtshar nus pa'i phul la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngo na rna ba'i bcud// dri za'i glu dbyangs 'dra ba brgya phrag mang*// mgur las mngon 'ongs thar par drang ba'i thabs// kun dga'i 'dod dgur 'char ba 'di na'o// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal ba'i dbang po gsum pa/ dpal 'brug pa rin po che zhes snyan pa'i grags pa sa gsum na khyab pa chen po de'i rdo rje mgur che ba'i rim pa dgung lo bcu dgu nas lnga bcu'i bar du phebs pa chabs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ dpal 'jigs byed he ru ka dgyes par rol pa'i gnas chen// dpa' bo dang dpa' mo sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i sa tsa ri tra bskor bar phyin pa'i tshe blangs pa lta sgom spyod pa gsum gyi glu/ dpal phun tshogs kun gyi byed pa po// yongs mi mngon dbyings kyi rdo rje 'chang*// dus da lta ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal// pha 'gran zla med pa'i zhabs la 'dud// snang thog tu tshol dang stong pa nyid// rig thog tu ltos dang gzhi rtsa bral// blta rgyu dang lta ba gnas rnyed// bzang ngan la rtsod pas (2na3)ci rang mdzad// lung rigs kyis 'jal ba ma yin pa'i// nyams su myong ba 'di gces par go// dpe khyung chen mkha' la lding ba bzhin// yid gzhungs nas sgoms shig pad+ma dkar// thol skyes kyi shes pa lhug par skyongs// tshogs drug gi stong du ma bcos glod// gang shar las gzhan du sgom mi snang*// sems 'dzin gyi spros pas cir mdzad// rgya 'byams su song ba ma yin pa'i// yid byed dang bral ba zhig /gces par go// dpe rgyun chad med pa'i chu bo bzhin// yid gzhungs nas sgoms shig pad+ma dkar// nyon mongs kyi rang ngo rjen par ltos// re dogs kyi steng du thog brdzis thong*// 'gal rkyen las gzhan pa'i mthun rkyen med// spang gnyen gyi blang dor ci rang mdzad// rgyu 'bras la khyad gsod ma yin pa'i// 'jar nyal 'khris med zhig gces par go/

dpe glang chen myos pa rgyug pa bzhin// yid gzhungs nas sgoms shig pad+ma dkar// mgon he ru ka dpal rol pa'i zhing*// ma mkha' 'gro'i dor tsa ri tra// nyams rtogs pa cig car nags ma'i ljongs// grub brgyud kyi mchod sdong dam pa na// rgyal khams la 'phyo ba'i bsam gtan pa// yid dga'i zhing skyid du tshor nas blangs// dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo dkon mchog rnams// dran gso'i glu shar kong po'i yul gyi sgrub gnas chen po me rag mdor mtshams kyi bcad rgya la 'dug pa'i tshe blangs pa/ blo ma spro ma spro nang du khug /blo spros na 'dod yon gyi snang ba dran// dga' gdungs kyi sred pa 'grogs yun ring*/ nyon mongs kyi dgra bo blo 'drid mkhas/ rnam rtog gi dpung tshogs rags la mang*/ bying rgod kyi so pa cang la grim/ (2ba4)dran shes kyi grogs po rgyu ma ring*// snyoms sems kyi le lo 'gro mtshams mkhas// col chung gi blo na 'gro la dga'// zhi gnas kyi yul 'khor 'joms nyen gda'o// kha nang du ltos shig pad+ma dkar// sems ma bcings ma bcings glod la zhog /sems bcings na phyogs bcur 'gro bar rtsom// rgya yan du gzhag na rnal du phebs// yengs med du bskyangs na rang mtshang rig /sdug btsir rang byas pa'i sgom gyis slu// bcas bcos ka ma byed lhug par zhog /tshogs drug gi snang ba thad kar khyer// kun rdzob kyi rdzu na phugs dbang med rdib// 'khrul tshogs kyi bros mtshang thams cad rig /dgra thabs kyi brtsom pa grogs su 'gro// 'khor 'das kyi zhe kho na gting nas sangs// zhes pa'o// mkhas pa phal cher chos brgyad phung pos ngal// sgom chen rnams kyang 'jig rten ri la 'dzin// da lta dus ngan snyigs mas gang ba'i skabs// snying nas lha chos byed pa shin tu dkon// rab byung khas 'che 'dod pa'i bran du song*// rtogs ldan rnams ni sgom ma'i rjes su bsnyeg

/sangs rgyas bstan pa nub la nye ba'i dus// thos bsam sgom pa tshul bzhin sgrub pa dkon// kun tu chos bzhin 'da' bar rdzu ba tsho// rkyen ngan gnod pa'i drung na dam chos yar// byas tshad don med 'gyur ba kho na las// rang gzhan phan dang bde la 'bad pa dkon// cher rlom phal cher grags 'dod re bas bcings// dma' rnams brnyas pa'i dong du lhung bas mnar// bar ma don med byams nyin mtshan brel// dal 'byor don ldan byed pa shin tu dkon// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag yin pa'i gtam// mang po'i dbus su rtag par sgrog byed kyang*// phyi tshigs gsog 'jog kho na sgrub byed pas// kha dang zhe phugs mthun pa shin tu dkon// tshul 'di gzhan skyon glengs pa ma yin kyang*// gnas tshul brjod pas (3na5)mtshang 'drur song ba yin// de las phyir zlog bstan pa'i rjes 'jug pa// thub gsung ji bzhin spyod pa shes ldan no// dman pa'i sa gzung hrul po'i gos gyon la// lto gos gtam gsum kun la gyong bskur te// dben par/ kun tu thos bsam sngon 'gro ba'i// rtse gcig sgrub pa snying por bya ba gces// dkon pa lnga yi dbyangs chung 'di// rtogs ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la// dge slong pad+ma dkar po yis// phan la re na blangs pa yin// zhes so// dal 'byor rnyed dka' yin pa shes gyur cing*// nam 'chi nges med pa'ang go mod la// las 'bras bslu med smin pa'i tshul mthong yang*// snying nas dam chos mi byed sgyid pa skyur// bsags pa kun gyi mtha' ma zad par go// 'dus byas myur du 'bral bar legs rtogs shing*// kun gyi chos nyid 'jig pa'i tshul rig kyang*// rtag rtsis gsog 'jog byed pa sgyid pa skyur// dge ba'i bar chod le lo snyoms las yin/ dge legs 'byung gnas thub bstan yun thung las// dge 'bras len la brtson par mi byed pa'i// chos par khas kyis 'che ba sgyid pa skyur// phan bde mtshan ldan bla ma las 'byung zhing*// de nyid mnyes pa'i thabs kyis bsten dgos kyang*// 'dod pa cung zad ma 'grub log lta sgom// tshe gcig sangs rgyas re ba sgyid pa skyur// chos rnams sems nyid gcig pu'i rol pa ste// 'dzin pa gtan la phebs na rtogs lags kyang*// bying rgod rmugs pa'i dbang du rtag par song*// stong skad gnam la 'phyar kyang sgyid pa skyur// sgyid skyur lnga yi dbyangs chung la// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'dus sa yod// sems la 'debs pa'i gzer chen yin// nyams len byed pa'i ngo sprod zab// ces 'di kong yul shar phyogs su// dge slong sangs rgyas 'brug rgyas la// 'gro bar chas pa'i dus su ni// pad+ma (3ba6)dkar pos gdams pa'o// gangs ri'i khrod na 'gran zla med pa'i sgrub gnas chen po// ra lung thel gyi dpal spos skya'i yang dben du bsgoms pa'i tshe/

rang la gros 'debs kyi glu mi rtag pa'i dpe bcu 'di 'then no// rgya gar na ḍom+bi he ru ka bod 'bangs kyis nā ro pa lo tsar btags/ rje de dang gnyis su dbyer med pa// dpal ngag gi dbang por gsol ba 'debs// kun rdzob rnams chu yi chu lbur 'dra// 'phral la skye zhing 'phral mar nub// gsab gsob la bden zhen ma che bar// snying po'i don la sgril cig yang*// 'dus byas kun chu shing sdong po 'dra// brtags shing dbyad na snying po med// blo bris kyi sgyu ma bkrag legs kyang*// 'dod pa dang sred pa ma skye ang*// lus bdag po med pa'i khang pa 'dra// phyi lo zla'i char gyis brdungs nas zhig /nang zhag dang za ma'i thigs pas bcom// rgyun rings kyi sdod grabs mi thub ang*// tshe ri gzar ngos kyi rbab dang 'dra// yud tsam zhig sdod pa'i long med par// 'chi bdag gi drung du 'bad pas snyeg /rtag rtsis kyi gshom ra ma 'dings ang*// srog 'tshub ma'i nang gi mar me 'dra// rkyen gnod pa kho na'i drung na 'khod// dar cig la thub kyang gdeng ma khel// long yod kyi le lo ma byed ang*// dbugs 'jag skya'i rtse mo'i zil ba 'dra// dus da lta rang la ma yal rung*/ yun ring po sdod pa mi srid pas// don med kyi bsam rgya ma che ang*// lus sems tshong dus kyi gnas mgron 'dra// lhan cig tu 'grogs pa'i de ma thag /phyogs phyogs su gyes nas 'gro dgos pas/ dga' gdungs kyi chags pas ma 'ching ang*/ 'chi ba kho nyi nas grib so 'dra/ phar phar bros kyang tshur tshur 'ded// cang 'khyug tu 'dzom yang thar sa med// mdo med kyi bya ba ma mang ang*/ mi tshe 'di bshas ra'i dud 'gro 'dra/ skad cig res 'chi bar nye ba la/ de ring dang sang gi (4na7)ngang rings na// mal mtha' nas 'o dod 'chor ro ang*// dal 'byor 'di mun khrod kyi glog dang 'dra// skam tsam zhig sngon bsags mthu yis rnyed// des yengs med phan bde ma bsgrubs na// phyis yang yang 'byor pa min no ang*// mgon grub pa'i 'byung gnas ra lung thel// gnas bkra shis g.yang chags nyams dga' yang*/

blo rgya 'byams btang bas don mi 'grub// lus dben par bsdad pa'i don go stor/ sems nang du khug la dran pas 'thul// spyir 'khor ba'i chos la yid brtan med// dgos 'dir zhen rang nyid sdug bsngal skyed// blo sred 'dod skyur cig pad+ma dkar// yang dben gnas de nyid du 'dag sbyar shin tu dam pas rig pa dngas snyigs phye/ de'i stobs kyis rnam par rtog pa ri gzar la chu rgyug pa bzhin shar/ ngos 'dzin gyi dran pa dang rgyu ring*/ 'bad pas bkug kyang yong ma nyan pas/ skyo grogs rgyang glu 'di la bcol ba lags so// dpal yon tan kun la dbang sgyur ba// mgon sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rin po che// mtshan yongs su grags pa'i kun spangs rje// bu gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// pha bla me dgyes pa'i ri khrod bsten// mig yar la bltas nas 'dag sbyar byas// phyi skye bo'i rgyu 'grul pad kyis chod// mthun 'jug gi ngo bsrung ngang gis dengs// rnam g.yeng gi 'du 'dzi rdog pas mnan// skyid 'dod kyi re ba rlung la bskur// grogs med kyi bsam gtan khang bur bsgoms// ngag long gtam 'phel ba'i smra ba bcad// sgo gsum dge sbyor gyi bsrangs su bcug /rang babs kyi bya ba chos su song*// gnas nyams su dga' la bag kyang phebs// yid gtod sa bzang bas dang yang spro// der rig pa dngas snyigs sangs kyis phyed// sems bcol chung po kho bzhugs ma nyan// sngar 'das kyi shul rjes thams cad (4ba8)bsnyegs/ ma 'ongs pa'i bya lo bye lo sems// da lta 'dod yon la dung dungs byed// ngal ba dang dub pa yang mi drag la// skyo sun gyi nyams kyang mi gda' 'o// gtad med la bkra lag che che mo// nyams kyang ni dga' la rgod kyang bro// mnan pas ni mnan pa'i yul dang bral/ ngos 'dzin gyi dran pa rgyu ma rings// dgos skabs der sleb pa'i dus ma byung*// bkug pas kyang 'gugs mkhan khong phyogs thal// phan 'dogs pa med la gnod pa mang*// blo rnal du phebs pa ci las dka'// zhi gnas kyi ting 'dzin rgyang ring bzhud// lhag mthong gi rtogs pa stsal du gsol// gang shar tsho rang sar grol ba dang*// yengs med kyi mnyam gzhag sbyin du gsol// snang stong gnyis ro mnyam 'gyur bar shog

/rje btsun khyod thugs rje'i gter mdzod lags// 'bangs nyams chung nga la byin gyis rlobs/// /yang de nyid du bskoms pa'i tshe yid la// mtshan ldan gyi gla mas ni rjes su bzung*// snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag ni thog zhe 'bod kyi spros pa ni zhi/ 'jig rten gyi 'ching ba ni grol// gnam sa cha lang bzhin du rdeb kyang nyam nga khu 'phrig ni med// las su bya ba ni dam pa'i lha chos kho na yin pas nyams dga' zhing skyid du tshor// 'di dag thams cad bla ma'i bka' drin du 'dug bsam nas gu yangs kyi rgyang glu 'di 'then pa lags so// sa gon phyag na pad+ma'i zhing khams kyi// yul g.yang chags dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mdud/ dpal grub pa'i 'byung gnas ra lung thel// ri spos dad can gyi yang dben nas// yid skyo bsangs kyi rgyang klu 'di ltar 'then// sngon sbyangs kyi las 'phro dkar po sad// gzhon nus dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs// thos bsam gyi shes rab mi dman tsam// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// bden bral gyi mun lam ma 'khyams par// dpal dgang po bka' (5na9)rgyud de la thug /'jig rten gyi 'khri ba ngang gis chod// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// rje rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// pha ngag gi dbang pos dbu mdzad pa'i// mtshungs bral gyi rje btsun 'ga' dang mjal// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin len du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// chos theg pa'i yang rtse gsang chen gyi// gnad zab dgu'i nying khu 'thungs lags pas// dus da lta shes pa gdengs dang ldan// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// ngan pa la spang blo ma skyes shing*// bzang po zhig bsgrub blom mchis pas// gang byung gis 'tsho ba'i stabs bde po// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// bzang ngan gyi snang ba ji snyed pa// rang sems kyi zlos gar sgyur lugs te// chu bo dang chu rlabs lta bur song*// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// sems nyid kyi steng du bltas lags pas// lta byed kyi shes pa dbyings su yal// blta bya dang lta mkhan thams cad zad// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// thol skyes kyi shes pa ma bslad pa// bzo med du bskyangs pas sa rgya chod// sems 'dzin gyi sdug sgur bya ma dgos// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// snang thog tu stong pa'i 'dug lugs rig

/stong thog tu snang ba'i 'char tshul go// gar shar la sgom gyi ngo ti byas// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin (5ba10)lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// blo re ba'i mgo bo dogs pas bcag /gang dogs pa'i steng du thog brdzis gtong*// khong gnam sa rdeb kyang nyam ming*// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// skyid na ni bde ba kun la bgo// sdug bsngal sngon las kyi 'khrud mar bltas// skyid sdug la gdam ka byed ma shes// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// zhes kyang smras so/// /yang kar 'brug gnyis 'khrugs pa'i tshe// yid la spyir snyigs ma'i dus su song*// sgos gangs can gyi skye bo rnams chags sdang gis mi bsrun par gyur pas don med du gnod cing 'tshol// ngan lan ngan gyis 'jal ba ni cha ma yin// rkyen thams cad grogs su 'gro ba ni dka'// de bas che thabs kyi spros pa spangs nas mi med kyi lung stong rnams su gcig pur bsgrub pa snying por byas na// bstan pa la'ang de ka phan sems can gyi don du'ang de nyid 'gyur che bsam// yid skyo dran 'debs kyi glu zhe mna' dgu ma 'di 'then pa lags so// dpal dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i sku// 'bangs dad pa'i snang ngor shar ba la// rje dag gi dbang po mi zer ram// pha gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// chu gter ltar g.yo ba'i zang zings nor// gcig byung gnyis dgos kyi ngang nas 'dzad// de phyug por gsogs kyang rtsod pa'i gzhi// da phyag dar rtswa bzhin mi 'dor ri// chu 'dzin ltar 'dus pa'i 'khor mang yod// snod ldan gyi slob ma srid pa tsam// 'du tshogs 'di gzhan rgyud 'khrug pa'i rgyu// nga gcig pur dben pa mi bsten ri// chu shing ltar snying po mi snang ba'i// nyam chung gi mnga' ris skyong bran la// zhe sdang gi dgra bo btul gyin ldang*// nga bcos ma'i che khyad mi 'dor ri// chu gter ltar gcig rjes gcig non pa'i// (6na11)las byed rgyu mang la zin rgyu chung*// de grub kyang 'tshengs pa mi gda' bas// nga 'jig rten bya ba mi gtong ri// chu rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i mi sems la// mthun 'jug gis zin du re na yang*// gcig gzung gnyis shor gyis sbyang grir shi// nga ngo bsrung thag pa mi gcod ri// chu rnyog ltar mi gtsang sgyu ma'i lus// gzhon lang tshos g.yogs dus dga' ba tsam// rgas rang bzhin bstan tshe skyug bro'i gnas// nga gcos pa'i bsrung skyob mi bshol ri// chu lbur ltar 'khrigs pa'i 'dod yon rnams// sngar 'dris kyi mig ngor bkrag legs kyang*// blo gzhigs na skyon gyi ltad rtse yin// nga zhen chags rtsad nas mi skrod ri// chu rgyun ltar rgyug pa'i tshe srog 'di// skad cig ma rer yang sdod mi khom// glo bur ba'i rkyen gyis shi yang srid// nga phyi bshol gyi snyoms las mi spong ri// chu shel ltar gang yang 'grib pa la// nam phugs zhig sems pa'i blo rgya yang*// rang sdug la rin gyis nyos par go// nga rang mgo chos kyi mi 'don ri// dus snyigs mar spyod pa'i gnas skabs 'dir// bdud rigs kyi bar chad mang lags pas// rang chos bzhin byas kyang gzhan gyis 'tshe// rkyen grogs su shar ba gshis kyis dka'// dran shes kyi gnyen po res 'jog la// yul ngan pa thams gyis spong zhes grags// nga de phyir mi med kyi lung stong 'gro ma// blo 'khor ba'i btson ras 'jigs lags shing*// 'chi bdag gis zin dogs lhag par bred// ma 'gro drug sdug pa shas mi bzod// btang snyoms su sdod par ci la nus// 'du 'dzi la dga' gdungs ga nas skye// blo rtse gcig dam pa'i chos la 'bungs// tshe blos btang sgrub pa'i rgyang so 'dzugs// yab dkar rgyud gong ma'i bshul rjes snyeg

/khyed rnams g.yeng 'dod pa'i 'khor slob dang*// khong 'dir snang sgrub pa'i chen po rnams// yongs skyid par snyeg gam 'khrug cing (6ba12)rtsod/ mi 'du long gang cher rgyug bshar byed/ rang gang mno lags so ci dgyes mdzod/// /yang*/ gtsang shar kha gzhung gi sa'i thig le/ rgyal byed kyi tshal chen po'i nags khrod na 'dug dus/ mtshan ldan bla ma dran pa'i mos gus kyis gdung bas yid brgyal ba sangs par byed pa/ bla ma rgyang nas 'bod pa rdo rje'i glu 'di nyams dbyangs su 'then no// dpal 'dzam bu gling gi byang gi rgyud// ri kha ba can gyis bskor ba'i zhing*// mi gdod dmar yul gyi lte ba na// ma mkha' 'gro'i mchod sdong ra lung thel// gnas g.yang chags grub pa'i 'byung khungs na// khong rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bka' bgros nas// 'bangs snyigs dus 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan la// mgon rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// mi gzugs kyis byon pa thugs rje'i gter// pha mtshan snyan ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal// 'bangs snying nas dran no bka' drin can// bu mos pas gdung la brtse bas gzigs// sku mthong na dga' ba'i gzi mdangs can// de bltas kyin mi ngoms mtshan dpes brjid// zhal mjal pa'i mod la snang ba bsgyur// blo chos kyis phrogs nas 'dir snang 'gag /lus bcos min dad pa'i ba spu ldang*// yid gdung shugs drag po'i mchi ma 'khrug /lag thal sbyar lha phyag ci yang 'tshor// rje mthong thos dran pa'i skad cig la// rkyen bar chad thams cad rang sar zhi// dpal nus mthu'i gong bu ra lung pa// 'bangs snying nas dran no bka' drin can// bu mos pas gdungs la brtse bas gzigs// khong skal ba bzang po'i tshogs kyi dbus// tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas rnyed sla ba'i// thabs rdo rje theg pa'i snying phyung ba// gnad zab cing 'dril ba'i chos kyi mdzod// tshig tha snyad tsam du mi 'jog par// don gcam bur ma lus yin lugs nyid// tshig snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis rjen par ston// mthar thug pa'i snying po gzhan (7na13)rgyud la// bde blag tu ston pa'i thabs mkhas po// mtshungs bral gyi rje btsun 'brug pa'i zhabs// 'bangs snying nas dran no bka' drin can// bu mos pas gdungs la brtse bas gzigs// tha mal gyi shes pa'i rang ma tshang de// gzigs lags pas dag dang ma dag pa'i// snang grags rnams phyag rgya chen por rol// bsgom bya dang sgom byed gnyis las grol// spang blang gi mdud pa dam po zhig

/sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa rang sar dengs// tshad med kyi thugs rje'i glong brdol bas// mkha' mnyam la khyab pa'i 'phrin las can// mtshan nyid kun ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes// skyabs gsum gyi mthar thug rin po che// 'bangs snying nas dran no bka' drin can// bum mos pas gdungs la brtse bas gzigs// tshe 'di nas phyi ma gar skyes kyang*// dus byang chub snying po ma thob bar// skyabs mgon dang re sa gzhan mi 'tshol// sgo gsum chig dril gyi blo bltos 'cha'// 'bangs dad pa'i gtsug rgyun mdzad du gsol// yid ltem rkyang med pa'i gsol ba 'debs/ rje mi mngon dbyings nas mi gzigs sam// nged khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// sdug bsngal gyi btson rar mi 'khor bar// bde chen gyi sa la skyel ba zhig /pha rje btsun mkhyen no thugs rje can/// /yang*/ dmar ser gyi me tog gzhon nu ma// zil dngar gyi lang tsho rgyas dus 'dir// dgra ba mo 'phog na mi rung bas// rogs lho sprin sbron cig rkang drug rnams// sngo ljang gi myu gu yid 'phrog ma// 'bras snye ma'i nu 'bur mtho dus 'dir// dgra ser ba bab na mi dung bas// rogs sngags 'chang sbron cig sred ldan tsho// dkar dngas kyi bdud rtsi'i 'od ldan ma// bcu drug gi cha shas gang dus 'dir// dgra mun can byung na mi rung bas// rogs brgya byin spron cig rgyu gsal nyams kyi zhi gnas la// blo so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis// khong nyon mongs 'khri shing gcod byed pa'i// chos rnam par 'byed pa'i ral gri 'tshol// khyod thog med ma rgal 'gro drug la// blo mnyam pa'i sems can de lta bas// da bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i byang sems bsgom// khyod byis pa rang gi don byas pas// blo gtan du ngal ba'i nyes dmigs la// yid bsams shing bdag gzhan brje ba'i sems// nad drag pos nyen pa'i sman bzhin bsten// khyod gdod nas dag pa'i byang sems la// blo bcos ma'i lhan pa ma 'debs par// gang spros dang bral ba'i de nyid la// sems spros dang bral bar mnyam par zhog

/khyod yon tan gong du bla ma la// blo log lta'i mchod pa ma 'bul bar// rje rnam thar ci mdzad legs mthong ba'i// da mos gus gyis dang don kun 'grub// khyod rtse gcig sangs rgyas thob 'dod na// blo rtse gnyis 'khri ba legs bcad de// (13ba26)pha bka' rgyud bla mar yid gtad na// don myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur ram// rang gi slob bu byang pa rab 'byams chos dpal bzang*// rig pa 'dzin par yang grags pa la ku ri byang chub snying po'i spo dam par gdams pa'o// 'dzam gling chu mtshon 'gying ba ku mud kyi sdong po// de la mdza' gcug sa su ldan pa chu shel gyi zla ba/ dus tshod nyin mtshan gyi bgrod pas zla ba ngas chas nas/ gling gsum nyin 'khor la byas nas lho gling 'dir sleb 'ong*/ 'od dkar dga' ston du 'gyed do ku mud kyi nags tshal/ sa mo sa ser ba las srungs shig sngags 'chang gi nag po// spang gshongs mthon po na mdzes pa spang rgyan gyi sngon mo/ de la mdza' gcugs su ldan pa stag chung gi bung ba/ dus tshod bser bu yi bskul bas bung ba ngas chas nas/ nags mtha' yud tsam gyis bskor nas spang gshongs 'dir slob 'ong*/ glu sgra dang dir gyis 'gengs so spang rgyan gyi tshal chen// me tog ba mo las skyobs shig lho sprin gyi smug po// lho brag lung gsum na skyid pa gnas chen gyi mkhar chu/ de la mdza' gcugs su ldan pa rnal 'byor gyi pad dkar/ dus tshod bya gzhag gis brel bas pad dkar ngas chas nas/ lho gtsang skad cig gis bskor nas gnas chen 'dir sleb 'ong*/ dam chos dga' ston du 'gyed 'dir bzhugs pa'i mchod yon/ khyed cag bar chad las skyobs shig bla ma yi dkon mchog /ces so/// /nags ljongs phal mo la 'grim pa rgya stag gi khra bo// tsan dan nags ma dang phrad pas sems yid la shor nas/ nags mtha' snyeg pa la mi dga' stag phrug gi gzhon nu// 'dzum drug bstan sa la bya yin tsan dan gyi nags ma/

gangs ri zur kha la 'grim pa seng ge yi dkar mo/ gangs stod mthon po dang phrad pas sems yid la shor nas/ zur kha snyeg pa la mi dga' seng phrug gi (14na27)gzhon nu// g.yu ral gsigs sa la bya yin gangs stod kyi mthon po/ mtsho mtha' sgor mo la 'grim pa 'gyur lcam gyi nya mo// chu klung dngas mo dang phrad pas sems yid la shor nas// mtsho mtha' snyeg pa la mi dga' ltang dkar gyi nya phrug /gsar mig blta sa la bya yin g.yu mtsho yi sngon mo/ dgung sngon mthon po la 'grim pa bya rgyal gyi rgod po/ brag dmar ri bo dang phrad pas sems yid la shor nas/ nam 'phangs spyod pa la mi dga' thang dkar gyi gzhon nu/ gshog phrug brkyangs la bya yin brag dmar gyi mthon po/ rgyal khams phyogs med la 'grim pa rnal 'byor gyi dpon slob/ gnas chen mkhar chu dang phrad pas sems yid la shor nas/ rgyal khams 'grim pa la mi dga' bstan 'dzin gyi gzhon nu// sgom sgrub 'dag sbyar la bya yin de wi yi ko ṭi/ zhes pa 'di gnyis shugs 'byung du gsungs pa'o/// /dgung sngon mthon po yi phyogs su// 'khrigs gdugs nyi ma yis sleb tshe/ me tog ge sar du rgyas pa/ rten cing 'brel 'byung du 'dug go rin chen skyed tshal gyi phyogs su/ rma bya gzhon nu 'dra sleb tshe// glu dbyangs zlos gar gyi rol pa/ rten cing 'brel 'byung du 'dug go// lho brag rong gsum gyi phyogs su// rnal 'byor dpon slob kyis sleb tsho// skal ldan ngal gso ru gyur pa// rten re 'brel 'byung du 'dug go// zhes mkho mthing lha khang du sde pa phyag rdor rab brtan pa la gdams pa'o/// /shre ya se stu/ nam gzhag gtan gyi skyabs gnas// mtshan ldan bla ma ru 'dug pas// gsol ba snying ngang nas thob dang*// dgos dgu yid bzhin du 'grub bo// sprul pas sprul sku yi bstan 'dzin// dgas po bka' brgyud du 'dug pas// 'di phyi'i re ltos 'dra zhus dang*// ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub bo// thog med dus nas kyi pha ma// 'gro drug (14ba28)sems can du 'dug pas/

snying nas ci phan zhig gyis dang*/ don gnyis yid bzhin du 'grub bo// 'di yang sde pa bstan 'dzin dbang bsgyur la gdams pa'o/// /dpyid gsum ldum ra ru skyes pa'i// me tog ha lo yi stong ldan// mdangs bzang ge sar du 'dzom dus// dkon mchog zhabs drung rang sten cig /tsan dan 'khri shing las skyes pa'i// bsrung zhim spos ngad kyi dam pa// lho phyogs rlung gzhon dang 'dzom dus// don mthun ngal gsos rang gyis shig /sngon bsags bsod nams las skyes pa'i// yon tan bdun ldan gyi mi lus// sangs rgyas bstan pa dang 'dzam dus// dam pa'i lha chos rang gyis shig /'di yang lha khang du sras mo rdo rje sgrol ma la'o/// /na mo rat+na gu ru/ phyi rma g.yang brag ri nags tshal can// nang dag pa lus kyi rtsa khams dang*// gzhan rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' glong ste// gnas ya mtshan lho brag mkhar chu'i ri// phyi ltar na dad ldan pho mo'i khrom// nang ltar na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// gzhan ltar na bdag gzhan gcig pa'i zhing*// gnas ya mtshan lho brag mkhar chu'i ri// phu gangs dkar haṃ yig bde ba'i gnas// mda' rong gsum tshad pa tsaṇ+ḍī'i me// bar 'bab chu'i rgyun 'di dga' bzhi'i 'gros// gnas ya mtshan lho brag mkhar chu'i ri/ g.yas mkhar chen waṃ yig rdo rje'i ri/ g.yon lcags phug e yig shes rab mkha'// dbus mnyam spyod zung 'jug yangs pa'i gling*// gnas ya mtshan lho brag mkhar chu'i ri// phyi snang ba brda thabs kyi rol rtsed kyis// nang rig pa sems kyi phugs bstan nas// gzhan phyag rgya chen por sbyor ba yi// gnas ya mtshan lho brag mkha' chu'i ri// phyi 'gag med kyi 'char sgo ji snyed pa// nang stong nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa'i// gzhan gsang chen gyi ltad mo snyeg 'dod rnams// gnas ya (15na29)mtshan lto brag mkhar chur byon// lcags phur can gyi phug pa gsang ba mchog gi zhing du/

pad+ma dkar pos nyams dbyangs su byas te/ sde pa chos rgyal bstan 'dzin dang chos rgyas rab brtan la gdams pa'o/// /brgyud pa de dgas po bka' rgyud la thug pa// bla ma de dpal ldan 'brug pa la zhus nas// blo rtse de tshe 'di blos btang la gtad pas// bsams kyin snang ba'i bde shos su byung ngo*// brtags kyin nyams bsangs dga' ba la byung ngo*// lta ba de phyag chen su gtan la phab pa/ sgom pa de chos drug gi gsang lam la zhus nas/ bogs 'don de ro snyoms skor drug la bcol bas/ bsams kyin snang ba'i bde shos su byung ngo*// brtags kyin nyams bsangs dga' ba la byung ngo*// che thabs kyi bcos ma khyad du rang bsad nas// gang byung la 'dun ma'i gtso bo 'dra zhus nas// gang dga' stabs bde la blo rtse 'dra gtad pas// bsams kyin snang ba'i bde shos su byung ngo*// brtags kyin nyams bsangs dga' ba la byung ngo*// ma rgan de 'gro drug gi sems can la byas pa// drin len de dam pa'i lha chos la zhus nas// nam gzhag gtan gyi don chen 'dra sgrub pa// bsams kyin snang ba'i bde shos su byung ngo*// brtags kyin nyams bsangs dga' ba la byung ngo*// zhes pa 'di yang cog bu ba dge slong shes rab 'phel la gnas chen mkhar chur gnang ba'o/// /tshe des med du 'dug pas snyoms las bsgyur// ma 'gro drug tu 'dug pas snying rje bsgoms// rje sangs rgyas su 'dug pas gsol ba thob/ sems chos skur 'dug pas rang zhal ltos/ yul sems gzugs su 'dug pas lhug par zhog /dge ba 'bun skyed du 'dug pas smon lam thob// ces phar gdod dbon po la gdams pa'o/// /tshe rabs kyi 'phreng ba grangs mang por/ bsod (15ba30)nams kyi tshod zong gis bsgrubs pa'i// mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun ldan 'dis// dus nam gzhag gtan don bsgrub pa gces// sdug bsngal gyi rba glong cher 'khrug pa'i// gnas 'khor ba'i chu bo mtha' med la// dus da re sgrol ba'i gru rnyed tshe// snyoms las dang le lo bskyur ba gces// yun bar snang glog 'gyu lta bu yi// blo skyo ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs su// brtson 'grus kyi bskul ma legs bsten nas// bde chen gyi go 'phang snyeg pa gces// zhes pa 'di yang khra bsam grub rab brtan rtse ra nang so ngag dbang la gdams pa'o/// /tshe 'di'i skyid dang 'dod la ma chags par// mi med dben pa'i gnas 'dir bsnyegs lags pas// bka' rgyud gong ma'i shul rjes ma non kyang*// 'jig rten khyim pa'i nang du 'khyams a mad/

lo gsar drang ngad tsha ba'i zla gsum la// gangs dkar bsil ba'i gling du bsgoms pa 'dis// gtum mo'i drod rtags yo tan ma skyes kyang*// grang ba'i nad bus zin dgos sdug bsngal med// tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags kyi mun rum na// gcig pu zla grogs med par bsdad pa 'dis// gnas lugs phyag rgya che dang ma mjal kyang*// bar chad bgegs kyi dbang du song dogs med// byis pa'i dus nas chos la thos bsam byas// gzhon pa'i dus nas sgrub la nan tan bgyis// 'chi yang dod pa'i gdengs tshad ma thob kyang*// rgas 'khogs 'chi ba gang la 'gyod pa med// bsam pas rang don bsgrubs pa rgyab tu bskyur// spyod pas zhi bde don gnyer khyad du bsad// byang chub sems dpa'i khrod du ma tshud kyang*/ dman lam nyan rang gnyis su gol ba med// don chung tshe 'di'i bya ba gdong 'ded byas/ gtan don dam pa'i chos la snying rus bskyed// bdag gzhan don gnyis myur du ma grub kyang*// bsam med dred po'i zla la shor ba med// bzang dang skyid pa dang du ma blangs shing*/ (16na31)ngan dang sdug pa ched du ma spangs pas// sgom chen rab kyi lam khyer ma thub kyang*// mtha' ma'i khrod du nam yang las pa med// che thabs bcos ma'i sdir kha dgra bor gzung*// grags 'dod snyan pa'i gtam la phyi thag bstungs// chos mdzad dam pa'i rgyal sa ma thob kyang*// ser gzugs khyim pa'i bran dang mtshungs pa med// ces pa 'di dpal mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo'i gnas/ cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs gyi yang dben nas lho phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang po mtsho skyes rdo rje la gdams pa'o/// /dpal 'gran bral bka' rgyud kyi bla ma dang*// mgon mtshungs med kyi chos rje khu dbon sras// sgos bka' drin can ngag gi dbang po la// nga kha tshig tsam min par gsol ba 'debs// grogs bzang po tshong dus mgron po 'dra// dus kha rtsang bar yod pa de ring med// 'dus pa so sor bral bas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// 'jig rten bya ba mdangs gsum rmi lam 'dra// da lta skyid skyid 'dra yang yud kyis sdug

/skyid sdug re mos 'khor bas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa/ ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// bsags pa'i nor rdzas sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra// ser snas snying du bsams pa dgra 'dres 'khyer// rang rdzas gzhan gyis spyod pas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// tshe 'di'i grags pa lung stong brag ca 'dra// da gi lhang lhang gsal (16ba32)kyang da lta med// snyan pa mi rtag 'gyur bas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// gzugs kyi mtho yor khang ba rul pa 'dra// bsrung skyob ci phan byas kyang nges par 'jig /mtha' mar dur khrod bor bas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// dbugs kyi 'gyu ba bar snang sprin dang 'dra// glo bur skyi bser rlung gis 'ded ring 'dis// na ma yal nges pa med pas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// tshe 'di'i bya ba chu yi gnyer ma 'dra// gcig shul gcig gis non par bsgrubs bsgrubs kyang*// mtha' mar zin rjes med pas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs// kho bo bsams kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// 'dir dgos blo sna bang mdzod mthil brdol 'dra// gtan don yal bar bor nas bkang bkangs kyang*// chog shes kheng rgyu med pas blo ma bde// blo bde khong du tshud dam rig 'dzin pa// ma tshud dben pa'i ri bor (17na33)bsgom du gshegs// 'jig rten g.yeng ba gzhog la bsgom du gshegs/

kho bo bsam kyin dam pa'i lha chos dran// bzang po'i grogs de mi rtag zhig pa 'dis// kho bo snying nas skyo bas tshugs pa med// khyod kyang nges par skyo zhing yid 'byung na// nga bzhin dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du byon// rgyal po'i pho brang dag tu yid phebs shing*// 'dod pa'i 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng bas yid brel na// bshes gnyen khyod kyang ne tso'i mkhas pa 'dra// snying nas mno bsam mthong la bsgom du byon// zhes pa gnas chen tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo nas rab 'byams smra ba chos dpal bzang la gdams pa 'di nyid gzhung lugs grangs su bcad pa bco brgyad dang*// ma bcad pa dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa bka' dang bstan bcos mang po'i blo nor gyis phyug pa ston sgom sangs rgyas legs pa de nyid dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe yid skyo shas drag pos bskul ba'i rkyen gyis so/// /sngon byon grub thob kyi dbus na/ rtsod med yongs grags kyi rje btsun// ras chung rdo rje yi grags pa// dad ldan gsol 'debs kyi bu la// byin rlabs dngos grub 'dras stsal dang*// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gyi dbus na/ 'ja' lus sgyu 'phrul gyi gar mkhan// ras chung rdo rje yi grags pa// dad ldan gsol 'debs kyi bu la// byin rlabs dngos grub 'dras stsol dang*// dam pa rigs brgya gi dbus na/ khyab bdag rdo rje'i 'chang dngos// ras chung rdo rje yi grags pa// dad ldan gsol 'debs kyi bu la/ byin rlabs dngos grub 'dras po la dang*/ zhis pa 'di yang*/ rje btsun ras chung pa'i sgrub gnas glon byes 'gol du// dam pa de nyid dran pa'i mod la pad+ma dkar pos bgyis pa'o/// /tshe sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i mi lus 'di// dus gtan don bsgrub na med mi rung*/ (17ba34)de shin tu yun thung 'jig sla ba// chos snying nas bzhed na le lo bskyur// lam zab rgyas gnyis la thos bsam 'di// blo rmongs pa sel na med mi rung*// de shin tu pha mtha' chod dka' bas// chos snying nas bzhed na brtson 'grus 'tshal// yid mnyam gzhag gi bsam gtan skyong ba 'di// 'di byang chub bsgrub na med mi rung*// de shin tu bying rgod 'phrang dam pas// chos snying nas bzhed na rtse gcig bsgoms// blo gzhan don gnyer ba'i sems bskyed 'di// dpal sangs rgyas bsgrub na med mi rung*// de shin tu spyod pa gting zab pas// chos snying nas byed na rang don bskyur// sde pa tshong 'dus par gdams pa'o/// /dpal longs sku'i zhing gi rdo rje 'chang*// 'gro drug gi snang ngor rol ba'i tshe// mtshan snyan po ngag dbang chos rgyal lo// pha rje btsun de yi bka' drin las// yun ring ba tsam rang ma sbyangs kyang*// chos lung rigs tshad mas gzhal ba la// dus deng sang smra ba'i seng ger gyur// khong mkhas pa tshogs kyen nga re brod// yid gnyen pa'i chu lon ma bran te// 'dod yon gyi snang ba ci bkra yang*// zhen chags kyi sred pa mi ldang bas// khong btsun po tshogs kyin nga re brod// rang nyid kyis ched du ma gnyer kyang*// gzhan phan la dga' ba'i bya gzhag 'dis// srid zhi yi phun tshogs zhar la byung*// long chen po tshogs kyin nga re bred// thos lo'i thob rgya mi che yang*// lam zab rgyas 'byed pa'i gdams ngag rnams// rang rgyud dang gcig tu 'dres pa'i phyir// khong gdams ngag can tshogs kyin nga re brod// 'dag sbyar gyi bsgom yun ma byas te// lam nyams su myong ba'i drod rtags la// ji lta ba'i spu ris phyed pa'i phyir// grogs sgom chen chogs kyin nga re brod// blo bcos ma'i tho co mi che ste// skyid 'dod kyi re ba ma byas pas// sdug dogs kyi 'dzin pa rang sar dag

/khong rtogs (18na35)ldan tshogs kyin nga re brod// gtor ma dang bzlas bsgrub mi brtson kyang*// ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong dgyes pa'i phyir// gang bsams kyi 'dun ma yid bzhin 'grub// khong dam tshig can tshogs kyin nga re brod// mi bdag gi brod pa 'di dag kyang*// pha mtshan ldan bla ma khong gi drin// drin 'khor thabs med pas gsol 'debs 'di// rje dam pa'i snyan la gzan yang byas// mi khyed kyang de bzhin 'byung 'dod na// dus 'di phyi'i re ltos ma mang bar// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma nyag gcig la// rtse gcig gus pa'i gsol 'debs kyis// zhes pad+ma dkar pos/ rgyud sde man ngag la thos pa can smon 'gro kun spangs pa la rgyal byed tshal nas gdams pa'o/// /dus de'i tshe/ mkhas blun mang po ni gu la sogs pa'i gdams pa min pa gzhan gyis go mi chod pa skad byed snang ba la zur zar blangs pa/ sngon sbyangs kyi las 'phros rgyud bskul nas// lam zab mo tshol ba'i spobs pa rnyed// lam 'bras dang ni gu sbyor drug sogs// bla med kyi snying por yid ches shing*// dbus gtsang gi ljongs na dar mod kyang*// dus ding sang kha bshad khram pa'i chas// lag len gyi 'phrang la rdugs mthong nas// zhu 'dod kyi spros pa de khar chab /snyan rgyud kyi chu bo bzhi 'dus pa'i// dpal nā ro'i chos drug g.yed chen po/ de bshad na rgya che gzung na yang*/ phyag bzhes kyi byin rlabs ma yal bas// yid rtse gcig sgril sa 'di la byas// sgam sgom gyi bla ma ma lags ma// yongs grags kyi rje btsun bsten las rnyed/ 'bangs sbyong ba'i ngal ba ma dgos par// chos kun la mkhas pa'i gnas thob pas// rje bka' drin can du cis mi shes// sku drin la 'khor thabs ga la yod// chos kha bo che ba mang na yang*// sngar bsgoms pas drod rtags 'thon pa ste// bka' rgyud kyi gzhung lam 'di ka mang*// nga bsams (18ba36)kyin 'tshengs so 'dir tshogs rnams// blo gsal pad+ma dkar po bdag nyid gnas chen de wi ko ṭi na/

dad 'dus kyi tshogs la ro snyoms skor drug la sogs pa'i zab chos thos bsgrags su byed pa'i tshe// chos pa bzang por rlom pa'i spyod tshul 'jig rten 'dir nang las ma 'phags pa mang du mthong*/ rang spyod dam pa'i chos bzhin du snang ba bla ma'i drin du shes pa'i glu 'di 'then pa yin no/// /na mo/ chos chos bzhin ston pa'i bla ma la// rje mtshan ldan 'brug pa skad kyin gda'// nga gzhan ma'i slob dpon mthong bzhin du// rje khong la bsams bzhin dad pa skyes// yid bltos pa bcas pa'i bu slob la// chos brgyad kyi gar bum bzos par// tshe blos btang sgrub pa'i gnas su bzhag /de dran kyin snying nas mos gus skyes// mgon mtshungs med de yi bka' drin las// blo bcos ma'i khrigs kham lags pa'i// nyams len gyi gdengs tshad 'di ltar thob// a la la thugs sar gtugs pa'i mthus// 'gyu byed kyi yal sa shes pa'i phyir// rnam rtog gi steng du thog brdzis btang*// spang blang du 'dzin pa'i gnyis chos zhig /ltas ngan pa g.yang lon bla ma'i drin// thabs mkhas kyi gnad ka ldan pa'i phyir// nyon mongs la bzlog pa'i bsgom pa byas// ye shes gsal 'debs kyi gdengs tshad lon// dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba bla ma'i drin// nang rtsa gnas rten 'brel shes pa'i phyir// 'khrul snang gi gdon la ro snyoms bgyis// bar chad dngos grub kyi rol par song*// bgegs rgyan du shar ba bla ma'i drin// 'gro ba kun pha mar mthong ba'i phyir// bdag gzhan gnyis brje ba'i byang sems bsgoms// sdug bsngal dang len gyi go cha thob// rkyen grogs su song ba bla ma'i drin// nad sgrib pa'i phyags mar nges pa'i phyir// phan 'dod kyi bdag 'dzin blos btang bas// 'byung bzhi ro snyoms kyi ltad mo mthong*// zug bde (19na37)bar shar ba bla ma'i drin// gzhi gnyug ma'i 'char tshul ngo 'phrod phyir// tshogs drug gi snang ba lam du 'khyer// 'od gsal gyi ma bu 'dres nas thal// 'chi dus su brod pa bla ma'i drin// bzang rdzu la re ba ma dgos par// lto 'grangs nyin dros kyi chos pa min// che 'dod kyi khong skran ma zhugs pas// ci drag gi rtsi kha zhu dgos med// ces smras so/// /gzhan don lhur len gyi bsam pa bcangs// lag len du bsdu ba bzhi bslabs// rang 'dod kyi khong mtshang yul nas bton// ya rabs gcod pa'i bu tsha min// lung rigs kyi tshig gis brdar sha bcad// mnyam gzhag gis don gyi sgro 'dogs bsal// 'chugs med kyi dam chos ngos su rnyed// rdzun 'ol bshad byed pa'i mkhas pa min// rang rig gi ngang du nyon mongs btul// las 'bras la yid ches blang dor byas// zhen log gis rlom pa'i dri ma dbral// tsher ma dar gtums kyi chos pa min// chos rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying rnams// lag len gyi 'phrang la brdar brdar ba'i// smar khrid du bstan pa rgyud la sim// chos dpe thog las pa'i mkhas pa min// gces 'dzin gyi 'gong po dran pas bsad// 'dod yon gyi ser ba gdong nas bzlog

/'jar nyal 'khris med kyi nyams len shes// bzang rdzu la skyabs pa'i sgom chen min// stong nyid kyi bsrung ba rang las rnyed// bdag 'dzin blos btang gi ngang du nyal// byar med kyi ngang du las kun zin// mtho co la re ba'i rtogs ldan min// 'jig rten pa'i mig ngor mdzes pa'i chos// khong che dgus hab bsha' mdzad pas zad// nyon mongs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i chos// mi rnal 'byor nga yi skal bar las// zhes smras so/// /byin rlabs kyi gong bu bka' rgyud la// mos gus kyi ltem kyang ma shor bas// sangs rgyas kyi sa la skyel mi skyel// rje khyed kyi thugs rjer (19ba38)dag la byung*// snyan rgyud kyi gdam ngag zab dgu shes// lag len gyi thad du ma rmongs pas// dngas ma'i 'ja' lus zhig 'grub mi 'grub// nyams su len tshul la rag las byung*// snying nas 'chi dran gyi bskul ma byung*// srid gsum gyi 'byor par ma chags pas// blo chos su 'gro ba yong mi yong*// thag chod kyi blo la rag las byung*// rgyud gnya' rengs yan par ma gtang zhing*// gzhan gnod kyi bya ba ma bgyis pas// chos lam du 'gro ba yong mi yong*// rlom sems yod med la rag las byung*// 'khor ba'i de nyid shes pa'i phyir// 'khrul med kyi sgrub byed ma bshams pas// lam 'khrul pa sel ba yong mi yong*// thog brdzis kyi spyod par rag las byung*// byams snying rje gnyis po khong nas brdol// sdug bsngal dang len gyi bsun ma byung*// gzhan don lhun grub zhig yong mi yong*// zhe 'dod bral ba la rag las byung*// 'di yang lcags phur can du sngags 'chang mkhyen rab rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor bgyis pa'o/// /yang gnubs kyi sngags 'chang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho de nyid// drag po mngon spyod kyi las la sun// rnam smin la bred// rang gis rang sun ma phyin par sgrub pa chos bzhin du byed dgos pa nam snyam pa'i the tshom log ge ba zhig 'dug pa'i tshe// pad+ma dkar pos gtam gros su bsnyad nas// brjed tho glur bkod pa 'di byas so// yul rgya gar dbus na sgra che ba// rje til+li nā ro skad par gda'// mgon mchog gzigs gnyis po'i rgyal sar bzhugs// mtshungs med kyi lo chen mar pa'i zhabs// mas khong la thug pa'i bka' rgyud 'di// chos lag tu bkal nas sems rgyud sbyong*// de byin rlabs tshan kha che ba'i phyir// grub thob kyi gter kha grangs med phyed// tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas bzhed pa na// mi khyod kyang sgrub brgyud 'di la zhugs// zin med kyi (20na39)bya ba bsgrubs nas ci// thag chod kyi mi tshe chos la skyol// rje ras chen dang zla 'od ngan rdzong pa// gling ras dang 'gro mgon gtsang pa'i zhabs// bka' theg pa rim dgur sbyangs rnams kyang*// drod rtags kyi yon tan 'di las 'thon// de bsams kyin gnubs kyi sngags 'chang khyod// rang sems la rang gis gros btab nas// dal 'byor gyi mi lus don ldan du// rtse gcig gis sgrub par mi 'byon nam// rnam g.yeng gi 'du 'dzi rgyang ring bzhud// mi dge yi chom rkun ngang gis zhi// bsam gtan gyi tsher mas dben pa'i gnas// dpal mkha' spyod dbang po'i do rar byon// ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gro de na 'du// dpal chos skyong bsrungs mas de na skyob// bag phebs kyi nags ma de na bzang*// tshe blos btang mdzad na de ru byon// gnas de na dud 'gro'i sems can yang*// mkha' spyod kyi sa la thogs med 'gro// rang shes ldan gyi mi la dgos pa'i rdzas// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub de la yod// ces smras so/// /'di phyi kun gyi skyabs mgon zhus// mtshan ldan 'thug pa kho rang la byas nas// snyigs dus khram pa'i bu slob la skyo ba'i// rgyad glu gnas chen mkhar chu nas then no// dad zas len dus kyi ham pa can tsho// zos tshad rgyal ba cig yin yin ma 'dra// rang rgyud de gyong pa'i shing ltar rengs dus// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// chos 'gal la spyod pa'i ngo lkog can tsho// gsangs pas nyes med cig yin yin ma 'dra// 'di phyi gnyis med kyi mkha' la 'khyom tshe// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// 'dod yon la sred pa'i don gnyer can tsho// bsgrubs tshad yags pa cig yin yin ma 'dra// ngan pa lang shor gyi bag chags 'thas dus// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// sdug dgos khong 'tshangs kyi ser sna can tsho// bsags (20ba40)tshad don ldan cig yin yin ma 'dra// 'chi bdag gtum po kho'i shab brgyugs sleb tshe// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// chen po la ring ba'i zhe 'dod can tsho// bsams tshad yong ba cig yin yin ya 'dra// don med rgyal sde yi mi khas bcom dus// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// gzhan skyon gleng bslang gi kha bde po che// bshad tshad yags pa cig yin yin ma 'dra// rang nyid mi kha'i 'dam rdzab la bying skabs// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// nyams len phyi bshol ba'i le lo can tsho// nyal tshad yags pa cig yin yin ma 'dra// ci yang mi nus pa'i blo dred khyer tshe// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// gdams ngag zin bris kyi khur po can tsho// btab tshad legs pa cig yin yin ma 'dra// chos dang shes rgyud tha dad du shor tshe// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// phan gtam la mi nyan pa'i dred po brgya tsho// byas tshad thog khel zhig yin yin ma 'dra// mi tshe ring po 'di 'byid dgos bab tshe// 'gyod pa skyes kyang 'phyis pa tsam min ne// zhes pa 'di 'ga' zhig la dgongs pa can gyis gnang bar gda'o/// /zhags pa de'u'i bla mar/

srid gsum gyi 'byor par ma chags par// tshe blos btang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs// tha snyad kyis 'jal bar mi nus pa'i// don rang rgyud la rtogs pa the mi tshom// mtshan ldan gyi bla mar gsol ba thob// tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i phun tshogs rnams// bde blag tu 'byung bar the mi tshom// dgra gnyen zhes ris su ma gcod par// bdag gzhan mnyam nyid kyi byang sems bsgoms// chags sdang gi ming yang mi grags pa'i// zhig po zhig 'byung bar gdon mi za// skyid 'dod kyi khong skran ma zhugs pas// rkyen thog tu spang blo ma shor na// chos rdzu la skyabs pa ma yin pa'i// sgom chen zhig yong bar the mi tshom// rang 'dod kyi (21na41)'dun ma rlung la bskur// zos bde la gtan gyi dgra bor gzung*// dug gsum la dran shes kyi so pa gzhog /gzhan don lhun grub cig the mi tshom// zhes so/// /lus bsgyur la chos go spyod spyod nas// gtan don gyi phan bde ma bsgrubs pas// tshe stong zad song ba 'chi kar tshor// de mthong gin snying nas lha chos dran// tha snyad kyi tshig gum 'thu 'thu nas// gal can gyi nyams len ma byas pas// chos mdo med las pa 'chi kar tshor// de mthong gin snying nas lha chos dran// tshul 'chos la khrims su sems sems nas// chags bral gyi zhen logs ras su bor// rgyud chos dang gyes pa 'chi kar tshor// de mthong gin snying nas lha chos dran// 'phral phyid kyi lho phyir ldom ldom nas// don ldan gyi sgrub pa byed ma khom// rgyud tha mal du las pa 'chi kar tshor// de mthong gin snying nas lha chos dran// kha bshad kyi khram pa byed byed nas// blo gtad kyi shes rgyud chud zos btang*// rang gzhan gnyis 'phung de 'chi kar tshor// de mthong gin snying nas lha chos dran// bag 'khyal la zhib por lta lta nas// rgyu 'bras kyi lha chos khyad du bsad// rnam smin gyi sdug bsngal 'chi kar tshor// de mthong gin snying nas lha chos dran// lar snyigs dus kyi chos par sems pa phul// rang nyid la mgo skor gyi g.yo thabs mkhan// khyed rang sems la rang gis gros thabs na// gtam 'di don la myangs kyin blang dor 'tshal// gnas khams gsum gyi 'khor ba nyam nga yang*// blo bag tsha mi dgos skyob pa'i gnyen// pha mtshan ldan gyi bla mas bskyangs pa'i bu// mi nga rang gi 'dun ma gang byas bde// zhes dka' bcu smra ba stag

/ming dngos dbang phyug dpal ldan la gnas chen mkhar chur gdams pa'o/// /na mo gu ru/ snyigs dus grwa slob lho rgyab 'khol po la// snyan rgyud gdam (21ba42)ngag thang mar brdal nas ci// de bas 'chad pa'i rnam g.yeng dor nas su// dben par rang sems 'thul dang pad+ma dkar// dus ngan mi 'di byas chung yus che la// bstun pa bde bde'i ngo bsrung byas nas ci// de bas tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas su// gcig pur nyams len gyis dang pad+ma dkar// gzugs brnyan btsun pa'i sdug gsog skyong bran la// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ming bzang btags nas ci// de bas 'dod pa'i 'du long bor nas su// rtse gcig sgrub pa gyis dang pad+ma dkar// rmongs pa'i khrod du yin lugs chos kyi gtam// dpe dang don du mthun pa bstan nas ci// de bas smra ba rgyang ring spangs nas su// rang rgyud chos dang bstun dang pad+ma dkar// zhes so/// /mtshan ldan gyi rje btsun 'brug pa'i zhabs// mi bdag gi spyi bor bzhugs nas kyang*// lus ngag yid byin gyis brlabs nas su// rje khyed rang 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyal khams na// blo gtad thub kyi bde ba ma mthong zhing*/ sgos snyigs ma lnga bdo'i bod yul du// yid bsams kyin dga' ba su yis rnyed/ nga de phyir dam pa'i lha chos la/ kha tsam zhig min pa'i 'dod pa skyes/ da tshe 'di'i 'khra ba bcad nas su/ gnas dben pa ma med kyi ri khrod du// rtse gcig tu sgrub pa snying por byed// blo snyoms sems le lo rgyang du dor// mthun 'jug gi ngo bsrung bskyur nas gtong*// 'di yang lha khang du sde pa sku skye la gnang ba'o/// /khu byug sngon mo lcang gseb rgyu ba dga' mo lta 'dug ste/ thag rnyi phra mos gar zin med la 'di skyo rang drags nas// gshog sgro brkyang nas snang ba de mo la skor ba bskor gyin// thang dkar rgod po'i phyir rjes snyeg pa la yid smon 'cha'o// nye'u skya bo chu mtha' bsil mos dga' mo lta 'dug ste// lcags kyu sngon mos nam 'debs med (22na43)pa 'di skyo rang drags nas// gtsang chab gzhung gi rba glong med pa la dpa' rtsal ngom kyin// nya chen yor mo'i phyir rjes snyeg pa la yid smon 'cha'o// pad+ma dkar po 'chad nyan byed pa dga' mo lta 'dug ste// 'chi bdag bdud pos nam sleb med pa 'di skyo rang drags nas/

'khri ba bcad nas mi med lung stong la sgrub pa byed kyin// bka' rgyud gong ma'i phyir rjes snyeg pa la yid smon 'cha'o// 'di yang shugs 'byung du bgyis pa'o/// /'khrungs sa bzang cig la bzang pa de phyi'i dang rgya mtsho// 'khrungs sa bzang kyang la ma chags pa'i me shel nyi ma khyod rang*// gling bzhi bskor kyin mun pa sel ba dga' mo lta yin te// 'bral bas skyo ba cig dog sa'i 'dab brgya nged la byung bas/ phyi mig cig gzigs nas dgung sngon mthon po 'di khar bzhugs dang*/ 'khrungs sa bzang cig la bzang ba de gangs ri dang dkar mo/ 'khrungs sa bzang kyang la ma chags pa'i dar seng dkar mo khyod rang*/ ri phug bskor zhing dpa' rtsal ngom pa dga' mo lta yin te/ 'bral bas skyo ba cig nags kyi ri dgas nged la byung bas// phyi mig cig gzigs nas ri ngos yangs pa 'di khar bzhugs dang*/ 'khrungs sa bzang cig la bzang ba de chos dbyangs dang spros bral/ 'khrungs sa bzang kyang la ma chags pa'i mtshan ldan 'brug pa khyod rang*// 'khor bar bskor kyin gzhan phan mdzad pa dga' mo lta yin te// 'bral bas skyo ba cig dad ldan bu tsha nged la byung bas/ phyi mig cig gzigs nas snying gi gur khang 'di khar bzhugs dang*/ 'khrigs gdugs nyi 'od lan brgyar 'thungs pas/ zil dang ra zhim po 'dab rgyas skyugs byung*// skyugs kyang chog snang ze 'bru rgyas zin// bsams kyin dga' nas bung pa nged tsho// bar snang bde mor phyam pas (22ba44)bya'o// dbyar gsum nam pa'i khu rlangs 'thibs pas// sbrang char zam zim sprin pas skyugs byung*// skyugs kyang chog snang chu ris g.yos drag /bsams kyin dga' nas rma bya nged tsho// dog sa bde mor phyam pas bya'o// zab rgyas chos kyi gnad mtshangs lon pas// gdams ngag zab mo bla mas bstan byung*// bstan kyang chog snang skal bar ldan 'dug /bsams kyin dga' nas rdo rje spun tsho// dor bde mor phyam pas bya'o// zhes so/// /sems 'thul gyi sangs rgyas ga na'ang dka'// sems 'dul la ma yengs pa'i sgom pa gces// sems rang rig gi gzhi rtsa chod gyur na// sems ngo shes kyi grub thob 'byung ngo bu// rkyen thog tu mi 'dre'i spyod pas ci// rkyen gang byung lam du khyer ba la// rkyen gang byung thug phrad 'bur 'jom gyis// rkyen snang rang grol du 'char nges yin// re dogs kyi 'ching ba ma grol bar// re ba'i 'bras bu mi rnyed pas// re ba gang byung dogs pa mthong*// re zhig na thams cad gnyen du khugs// mnga' ris zangs dkar ba dpon po blo gros la mkhar chur gdams pa'o/// /mi rtog pa la lhod de bzhag pas// bde ba'i rang gdangs 'od gsal du shar nas// 'gyu ba'i phu thag rig thog tu bcad pa// a le ma dpa' bo dga' ba'i glu sgra// la le ma dpa' mo dgyes pa'i gar stabs/

a 'o byas rtse gcig gi do rar shigs shigs// 'khrul thog tu glod pas dor rgyu ma rnyed// grol thog tu bzhag pas bsnan rgyu zad 'dug /blang dor med pa 'di sems kyi gnas lugs// dga' 'o byas bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod sprin// skyid do byas mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i dam rdzas// spros bral gyi mkha' la 'bol le 'dzom 'dzom// yul thog tu bzhag pas stong par langs song*// sems thog tu gnas pas bde chen du grol ba// zung 'jug 'di snang sems kyi steng nas rnyed (23na45)ba/ a'o g.yas pa 'di rdo rje'i gar// to khyangs g.yon pa 'di dril bu'i 'dug stangs// ro gcig gi do ra la ral sa gsig gsigs pas bya'o// mnyam nyid las gtan du ma g.yos// thugs rje'i chu bo ni brdol// gang byas chos sku'i yo lang 'di kha /dga' 'o smras te g.yas pa rgyob// skyid pa smras te g.yon pa bsgyur nas// sgom med chen po na 'bol mo shog shog /dpon tshang lha mo rig 'dzin la blo gsal pad+ma dkar pos sbyin pa'i glu'o/// /rgyal byed kyi tshal du rang spyod la bsams gzhigs btang bas yid skyo// bla ma dran// pha rjes su bsab pa zhig ma byung na brgyud pa bzang po 'di'i rigs su skyes pa la don mi 'dug bsam nas glu 'di blangs so// rje dran gyin du gdung sems je cher 'phel// 'bangs nga yis ni 'di phyi bar mdor// blo gtod sa ru byas pa khyod las med// pha mjal tsam zhig gnang dang 'brug pa'i rje// nga bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan zhig skyong ba 'di// mi chen po'i ngo 'dzin gyi thes su 'dug /zin med kyi sems gzung 'di bskyur nas su// pha khyed rjes 'brang ba'i lha chos zhig byed// bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa zhig byin gyis rlobs// ming btsun pa skad btags pa'i blo 'drid kyi// skra med kyi drung 'khor bskyang bas ni brel/ dgos med kyi 'du tshogs 'di bskyur nas su/

pha khyed rjes 'brang ba'i lha chos zhig byed/ bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa zhig byin gyis rlobs// kha bshad 'dod bsgrub pa'i bslab sbyangs 'di// tshe phal cher zad 'jug gi snyad khar go/ khram gtam la zhen pa 'di bskyur nas su/ pha khyed rjes 'brang ba'i lha chos zhig byed/ bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa zhig byin gyis rlobs// chos bshad do snyam nas yus pa 'dis// thos lo don gnyer ba'i tshe 'byid du go// 'khor med kyi g.yar khral 'di bskyur nas su// (23ba46)pha khyed rjes 'brang ba'i lha chos zhig byed// bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa zhig byin gyis rlobs// gzhan phan du bsams nas 'gro 'gro ba// byed dgos nges kyi bya ba'i bshol 'debs te// da mi khyu'i bshul snyeg 'di bskyur nas su// pha khyed rjes 'brang ba'i lha chos zhig byed// bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa zhig byin gyis rlobs// nye'o snyam bsam nas 'grogs 'grogs pa// snying gtam de rlung la bskur mkhan du mthong*// gnyis tshogs kyi yong gtam 'di bskyur nas su// pha khyed rjes 'brang ba'i lha chos zhig byed// bu'i 'dod don 'grub pa zhig byin gyis rlobs// zhes so/// /dpal phyogs dus kun las rnam rgyal ba'i// mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo ra lung pa// mtshan thos pas 'tshengs pa'i rje btsun khyed// 'bangs rnam g.yengs can la thugs rjes gzigs// chung ma las skyes nas da bar la// tshe blos btang gi chos shig bya'o snyam// 'phral bstan par bsnyad pa'i 'dzin skyong 'dis/ sngan chad kyi bsam mno ngo mar thal/ da dung mthun 'jug la mi 'byams par/ chos snying nas byed par thugs rjes gzung*/ chung bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs tsa na// chos rgyud khel ba zhig bya'o snyam/ 'phral bshad par bsnyad pa'i khram gtas 'dis// sngan chad kyi bsam mno ro mar thal// da dung tha snyad la mi 'byams par// chos rkyen dang 'dre bar thugs rjes gzung*// chung smra shes don go tsam tshun nas// rgyun nyon mongs 'thul pa zhig bya'o snyam// 'phral 'brug par bsnyad pa'i phyogs ris 'dis// sngan chad kyi bsam mno ro mar thal// da dung chags sdang la mi 'byams par// dag snang 'byongs pa zhig thugs rjes gzung*// chung mtshan ldan bla mas zin tsa na// brgyud pa zin pa zhig bya'o snyam// 'phral gdul byar bsnyad pa'i 'du long 'dis// sngan chad kyi bsam mno ro mar thal// (24na47)da dung rnam g.yeng la mi 'byams par// 'brel tshad don ldan zhig thugs rjes gzung*// 'di yang rgyal rtser ro/// /dang po lha chos tshul bzhin mdzad nas// bar du mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te// mtha' mar gzhan don 'ba' zhig mdzad pa// nga yi dang bla ma mtshan ldan 'brug pa khong yin// dang po lta bas sgro 'dogs bcad nas// bar du rlung sems thig le gcun te// mtha' mar spyod pas bogs 'don byed pa// nga yi dang dam chos bsre 'pho skor gsum khong yin// dang po tshe 'di'i zhen pa dor nas// bar du thos bsam sgom la 'bad cing*// mtha' mar rang 'dod yul nas 'don pa// nga yi dang rnam thar gzhan don byed pa khong yin// dang po lang shor sems rgyud btul nas// bar du rig pa rang so gzung ste// mtha' mar rkyen gyi thog tu bsre ba// nga yi dang nyams len ma bcos gzhag pa khong yin// dang po rtsol bsgrub rnam g.yeng ma mchis// bar du bsrung skyob ngal ba med cing*// mtha' mar mdzad pa'i dogs pa bral ba// nga yi dang 'phags nor bcud len zab mo khong yin/

'di byang khri lcam la'o/// /mtshan thos kyin du skyob bsangs pa'i rje// yid dran gyin du mos gus skye ba'i mgon// blo bsam kyin du thugs rje che ba'i skyabs// sems brtags kyin du dren can 'brug pa mkhyen// tshe 'di la tsam thub kyi nges med// 'chi bdag ni dal brel gyi dus mi blta// rkyen glo bur du 'ong pa 'di mthong bzhin du// snying nas kyi lha chos shig mi byed ri// blo mdza' bas kyang bshol ba'i skabs med cing*// yid gcugs kyang ni 'dzin pa'i mthu zad nas// nye du dang 'bral ba 'di mthong bzhin du// snying nas kyi lha chos shig mi byed ri// yul khang khyim btsan pa tsho phyi nas bor// nor bsags pa'i phyogs la ni mig ce re// rang lag stong du chas pa 'di mthong bzhin du// snying nas kyi lha chos shig mi (24ba48)byed ri// lus gces gces su bskyangs pa bltab ste bzhag /byad phyi bstar gyis sbyangs pa bya khyis za// ming tsam gyi lhag ma 'di mthong bzhin du// snying nas kyi lha chos shig mi byed ri// chos kha bshad kyi yong shas dgos kar gtong*// tshe som gnyis kyi byas pa khram par shes// 'chi dus kyi brad sdangs 'di mthong bzhin du// snying nas kyi lha chos shig mi byed ri// ngas gtan du gang phan gyi mno bsam btang*// tshe blos btang gi chos las gzhan ma rnyed// sngan chad rkyen dbang gis cung zad gnod// da zhen pa'i 'khri ba mi gcod ri// mi nged phyir 'brang 'dod kyi chos mdzad rnams// kha mkhas dang lus bcos la ma 'byams par// pha bla ma'i bzhugs gnas ri khrod du// gyong lto gos gtam la bskur te sgrubs// 'di yang rgyal rtse ru'o/// /ngas bka' rgyud kyi snying po 'brug pa bsten// chos shes sar gtugs pa'i gnad ka des// phyi snang srid kyi 'khor lo dpe char shar// sdug btsir gyis bslab sbyangs zhig ma dgos par// blo rno zhing gsal ba'i mkhas par gyur// shes so snyam sbos pa tsho'i 'ju sman yin// a la la bden rdzun thug na gsal// mi rlom pa can yod na rtsod pas chog

/ngas rang rgyud la ngan lang ma btang bar// blo dran shes kyis nyams su bstar ba des// khong dug lnga'i dgra bo rnams srid du chod// sdug 'khums kyis sgo gsum ma mnar bar// grogs 'phags pa rnams dgyes pa'i btsun par gyur// btsun mi btsun gzhal ba la 'byed thang yin// a la la bden brdzun gnyis gzhigs na gsal// mi sum nyi can yod na ngo lkog gzigs// ngas gzhan don 'ba' zhig sems sems nas// rang 'dod kyi khong mtshang tsho 'thon pa des// sdug bsngal dang len gyi go cha rnyed// phyogs ris kyi rmongs zhen ma mchis par// byams snying rje tshad (25na49)med kyi gzhan dbang song*// khong bzang por grags pa tsho'i bkru sman yin// a la la bden rdzun 'brel gyin gsal// mi log lta can yod na nye ring ltos// 'di yang rgyal rtser lho pa dpon tshang lha mo rig 'dzin la'o/// /nam gzhag gtan du ba'i skyabs mgon// rus gsum sangs rgyas kyi spyi gzugs// bltas pa ngos med kyi sku can// mtshan ldan 'brug pa de dran pa// tha snyad lung rigs ngang mthun pas// yin lugs nges don la gzhol ba'i// gang gsung gdam ngag gi gter chen// mtshan ldan 'brug pa de dran pa// skal ldan chos byed kyi dbus na// dad ldan thar pa la dgod pa'i// ya mtshan rnam thar gyi rol pa'i// mtshan ldan 'brug pa de dran pa// yon gnas rje btsun gyi dbus na// mnyam med dgas po yi dkar brgyud// kun 'dus yid bzhin gyi nor bu// mtshan ldan 'brug pa de dran pa// mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya// khams gsum 'khor ba las phyungs nas// thar pa'i bde lam la 'god pa'i// mtshan ldan 'brug pa de dran pa// snyigs dus bshes gnyen gyi khrod na/ chos brgyad mgo snyoms su byed cing*// dam chos dam chos su ston pa'i// mtshan ldan 'brug pa de dran pa// ces so/// /khong thul bar dka' ba'i bdag 'dzin 'di// sems gnyug ma'i pha mkhar dang phral nas// gnas mi bzad 'khor ba'i brtson rar bcings// dgra de 'dra thul na dpa' bo yin// don yin lugs rang ngo shes pa 'dis// spang gnyen gyi re dogs kun bral nas// gnas zhi ba'i bde la skyid du bcug

/gnyen de 'dra mthong na pho skyes zer// ces so/// /a'o rang dro 'jam da khyongs nas 'khrigs gdugs nga sleb yod// dga' mos gyis ang dgung bsangs kyi mthon po// bsam tshad 'grub pa 'dab brgya la 'od dag /(25ba50)skyid zer ra g.yu sbrang gzhon nu'i bgos skal// sbrang char thogs nas lho sprin nga sleb yod// dga' mos gyis ang nam la'i rgyal mo// bsam tshad 'grub pa dogs la 'ong dag /skyid zer khu byug sngon mo'i bgos skal// legs bshad 'khyer nas pad dkar du sleb yod// dga' mos kyis ang thub bstan gyi bgres po// bsam tshad 'grub pa thar 'dod la 'ong deg /skyid zer ra dad can slob ma'i bgos skal// 'di rnams 'phyong rgyas su'o/// /dpal dri ma mod pa'i zhing khams su// yongs nyi zla ltar grags shing rta'i srol// rje bka' rgyud bla mas gtod pa'i lam// sems gnyug ma'i don dang sprod pa'i thabs// yid rtse gcig tu bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// mchog thar pa'i go sar 'jug pa la// bde blag tu gegs med shis par rnyed// ma khams gsum 'gro ba'i don 'grub cing*// dpal 'brug pa'i bstan pa dar ba snyam// 'di gzhung gser tog du'o/// /rje dran kyin du gdung shugs je cher thal// rje dran bzhin du gdung sems mi 'phel du// sngar mjal sa yod pa dang da ma 'dra// pha khong gi rnam thar de gzhan la med// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// khong mi tshe ring sbyangs pa'i mkhas pas kyang*// don yin lugs su bsnyad pa blos mi 'chun// pha gcig shes kun grol gyi rgyal khams na// chos tshig re la 'khor 'das kyi mdo rgyas ston// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms gyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// khong gdams ngag sna tshogs pa'i gter bdag po/ lam bsgyur kha bsgyur kha la sangs rgyas 'tshol// pha ma yengs pa'i 'jog tshul gcig pu la// theg gsum gyi byang chub de so sor byon// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms (26na51)kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// kho'o sgrub pa mdzad mdzad pa'i zhig po cho// blang dor gyi spu ris de ci las phyed// pha rkyen ngan la dge ba'i bshes dgongs nas// lam gang shar la dgag sgrub mi dgos gsungs// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// khong phal cher byang sems kyi zhal po 'don// mi gzhan ma legs pa'i tshe sdug bsngal mdzad// pha rang nyid ni dman pa'i khrod zhugs nas// mi gzhan ma ci legs kyi thabs rtsol mdzad// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// khong 'dul khrims la gtso bor mdzad dgongs pa/

sde dgon gyi khrod du ka kha 'tshol mdzad// pha nyon mongs kyi sngan chad rengs rengs pa'i// rang sems 'di btu la na 'dul bar ston// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// khong yi dam gyi lha tshogs bsnyen sgrubs// phyi dgra bgegs kyi steng du 'phrin las ston// pha rang lus kyi lha la mchod mchod nas// dgra ngar 'dzin gyi steng du mthu gtad spungs// 'di bsams kyin du bla ma dran// khong yi dam gyi lha tshogs bsnyen sgrub pa// phyi dgra bgegs kyi steng du 'phrin las ston// pha rang lus kyi lha la mchod mchod nas// dgra ngar 'dzin gyi steng du mthu gtad spungs// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// bsgoms kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// khong snang ba la rang dbang 'dus 'dus po// myos byed kyi rang nyams ston ston pa'i ngang*// pha gzhan gyi don du ni mi 'gyur na// sku rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ba mi mnga' bas// 'di bsams kyin bsams kyin du bla ma dran// (26ba52)bsgoms kyin du mtshungs med kyi 'brug pa dran// 'di rgyal byed tshal du shugs 'byung du'o/// /nga'i dang bla mtshan ldan 'brug pha la thugs rje yod grag 'o 'phrin las 'chol dang ya'i// nga'i dang pha yul rgyal khams phyogs med la gu yangs yod grag 'o nyams dga' skyongs dang ya'i/ nga'i dang nye tshan 'gro drug sems can la nye rings med grag 'o byang sems spyongs dang ya'i// nga'i dang pha nor 'phags pa'i nor bdun la zad pa med grag 'o kun la bgos dang ya'i// nga'i dang lta ba phyag rgya chen po la ltad mo sa dang ya'i blta rgyu e 'dug gzigs/ nga'i dang sgom pa nā ro chos drug 'di yengs med sgoms dang ya'i zab khyad e 'dug gzigs/ nga'i dang spyod par snyoms skor drug la spyad pa spyod dang ya'i spang blang e 'dug gzigs// nga'i dang 'bras bu shar grol dus mnyam la ya mtshan yod grag 'o re dogs e 'dug gzigs/

blo bde po gu yangs pa gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du blo bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde la gu yangs pa 'khrul lugs 'khor ba'i rang mtshad rig pa blo bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs la da lta gang shar gzhi med rtsa bral blo bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs pa tshogs drug snang sgyu ma'i glong du bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs pa rang sems stong pa gshis dang 'dres pha blo bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs pa da lta snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan blo bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs pa 'khor 'das chos gyi rdzun phub rdib pa blo bde po gu (27na53)yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs pa bsam gyis mi khyab gnyug ma'i ngang du blo bde po gu yangs pa/ blo bde po gu yangs pa da lta snang srid dag pa rab 'byams blo bde po gu yangs pa/ 'di gnyis 'phyong rgyas su rgyal bu sku gzhon pa 'chos bro'i tshul du bgyis so/// /'og min pa'i ston pa'i gces phrug la// rgya gar ba mchog gzigs rnam gnyis zer// mtshan brjod na til+li nā ro lo// paṇa grub kyi dbus na khyad du 'thon// gangs can na sngon tshe bstan pa dar// gsang chen gyi theg pa sbas nas spyod// sdig spyod kyi rgyal pos bsnubs pa'i rjes// bka' dri med lag tu dri mar len// der skye dgu'i bsod nams tshong zong gis// 'phags mchog gi thugs rje nyos pa la// 'jig rten gyi dmigs bu mtha' dag byon// khong de pa'i dbus na sgra che ba// rje mar pa'i lo tsa skad kyin gda'// mi khong gi rjes 'jug grub pa'i khyus// mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams dog por btang*// pha der rjes 'brangs pa'i bka' rgyud pa// tshe blos btang chos cig snying bsams// 'jig rten pa'i mthun 'jug la de mi brtsi// sngon bsags kyi nus pas 'phangs pa yis// 'phral 'byor par snang yang zhen pa med// mi phrag don can gyis dgag mi thub// thugs lhod der bzhugs dang dad pa can// rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku rdo rje// brtan g.yo kun dang mnyam pa nyid// de sna tshogs gzugs brnyan sprul sku'o// sku ma mjal dgongs pa mdzad mi dgos// shar tshad mos gus su 'khyer ba 'tshal// 'di rdo rje theg pa'i gseb lam yin// rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung rdo rje// zin ma zin sgra dang mnyam pa nyid// de gzhom med thams cad mkhyen pa'i skad// don de phyir grag tshad bla ma'i gsung*// gsung ma thos dgongs pa mdzad mi dgos// ci gsan mos gus su (27ba54)'khyer ba 'tshal// 'di rdo rje theg pa'i gsang tshig yin// rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs rdo rje// rtog mi rtog kun dang mnyam pa nyid// de lhan skyes rnam pa thams cad pa// don de phyir dran tshad bla ma'i thugs// drin ma bskyangs dgongs pa mdzad mi dgos// rig tshad mos gus su 'khyer ba 'tshal// 'di grub thob kun gyi thugs kyi bcud// ces pa 'di byang khri lcam kun dga' dpal sgron la'o/// /snying rje can gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas skad// rje de dang gnyis su ma mchis pa// mi kho bo'i snying ga mdzes pa'i rgyan// dpal phyogs dus kun las rnam rgyal ba// pha grub pa'i rigs bdag 'brug pa'i zhabs// sa gsum gyi mchod rten de la 'dud// gzhan nga zer ya mtshan mi che yang*// khong rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams bgros pa'i// rtogs pa don brgyud kyi gsang tshig thos// de gzhan la ma grags snyan pa'i gtam// dus da res cung zad dbyangs su 'then// blo gnyis snang la mtho reg ma thongs par// las 'bras la skur pa ma 'debs ang*/

'di 'khrul ngor snang ba ltar smin la// don brtags na mi bzod chu zla'i gar// rang zhi ba don gnyer lam zhugs nas// nyams bden pa'i de nyid 'tshol ba la'ang*// theg dman zhes skur pa mi gdab ste// mthar thug gi theg par mchongs stegs yin// thabs kun rdzob byang sems la sbyangs nas// tshogs gnyis kyi bsags pa'i 'tshol ba yang*// ring lam zhes klan ka'i snyad ma bkod// rgyu 'bras dbyer med kyi khyer tshul yin// bya ba dang rnal 'byor gang gis kyang*// nyon mongs rnams kha sgyur byed pa yang*// bsgyur lam yin no zhes 'jog mi dgos// mnyam nyid du khrid ba'i snyad ka yin// gzhi dngos po'i gnas tshul gtan la phab// lam smin par (28na55)byed pa'i dbang la zhugs// don bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams su bstar// 'bras yin lugs yin bzhin mngon du gyur// 'di grub thob kun gyi zhal skyin te// dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa'i don// ma mkha' 'gro rnams kyi khong pa'i snying*// rgyud zab mo'i zho las mar lta bu// mi nga dang nga 'dra'i chos skal yin// lus khams drug ldan pa'i chags tshul bstan// rtsa phra rags dbu ma'i rim par phye// rlung las dad ye shes 'jug ldog gsal// khams thig le rang bzhin rnam 'gyur brjod// don zab gsal zung 'jug yin par bshad// gtan la phyag chen du khrid nas 'bebs// rtogs pa'i don dbang zhig thob bam blta// gang zag la bskal na mos rjes bskur// dang por bskyed rim la zung 'jug slob// nges thun mong gi sgrub chen a cang che// 'ga' zhig la mchog gi bden pa'ang ston// brgya gal te 'gyangs na gtum mos khrid// gnad rdo rje'i lus la rlung sems gcun// rdzas phyag mtshan sgom pa'i tsaṇ+ḍī sbor// nyams sems khar 'jogs zhar la 'byung*// khyad thig le nā da'i gtum mos 'don// mchog gnyug ma don gyi bsun ma sleb// dus de nas rdo rje 'chang du 'gro// 'ga' zhig la btsan thabs pho nya'i lam// rten phun tshogs 'byor ba'i mthu las khrid// yul stong bzhir sbyangs pas de dang der// thabs dga' bzhis ye shes myu gu skyed// yang na ni sgyu ma gsum gyis 'khyud// nyin snang rnams 'ja' tshon 'dra bar dngas/

mtshan dus su 'dod dgur sgyur ba thob// bar do mi 'khrul te longs skur 'byongs// don mngon par byang chub kyi lam la zhugs// zung 'jug gi sku gnyis rim pas bzhengs// tshe 'di la longs med g.yengs pas 'khyer// bar du dang po la nam yang 'grub// nyams thod brgal 'byongs na grong 'jug brten// (28ba56)lam sbyangs pa dman na 'pho bas bsu// rgyud spyod pa bogs 'byin ro snyoms drug /'di kha sbyor yan lag bdun tshang ba'i// lam rdo rje'i sa la myur du skyel// ci 'gyangs kyang skye ba phyi ma tsam// de phyir dam tshig gi gnad la bsgrims// ci byed gzhan don du song ba na// dge yang 'tshengs la sdig kyang 'tshengs// zhes paṇa chen dbon mdo sngags kyi zhung lugs brgya phrag smra ba gang de gangs ri chen po ti se'i rdor 'dzad la chas pa'i dus su pad+ma dkar pos gdams pa'o/// /gnas gad pa gser gyi bya skyibs can/ nyams dga' skyid 'dzom pa'i nags gyi khrod/ dpal cog sgar shel gyi gzhal med nas/ da rnal 'byor skyid pa'i glu cig len// sngon sbyangs kyi las 'phro dkar po sad// btsal ni mtshan ldan gyi bla ma btsal// thug ni yid bzhin gyi nor bur thug /bsam tshad 'grub pa 'di rgyan du che// 'di bsam kyin byas pa'i las la 'tshengs// 'di brtags kyin 'dug ma'i yang rtse ang*// sngon sgyangs kyi las 'phro chos su sad// bslab ni snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa bslabs// shes ni mdo rgyud thams cad shes// gcig shes kun grol 'di rgyan du che// 'di bsams kyin byas pa'i las la 'tshengs// 'di brtags kyin 'dun ma'i yang rtse ang*// sngon goms kyi bag chags bzang po sad// byas ni dam pa'i lha chos byas// byung ni mi chen gyi mgon cig byung*// 'di phyi gnyis 'grub 'di rgyan du che// 'di bsams kyin byas pa'i las la 'tshengs// 'di brtags kyi 'dun ma'i yang rtse ang*// sngon las kyi goms pa ngang gis sad// byas ni sems can la gang phan byas// byung ni thub bstan gyi dpal cig byung*// 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum 'di rgyan du che// 'di bsams kyin byas pa'i las la 'chongs// 'di brtags kyin 'dun ma'i yang rtse ang*// (29na57)gar gser du dpon drung mgon po rab brtan pas bskul ba'i rkyen gyis so/// /rje bzang ngan gyi rtsod pa mi dgos par// mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid ldan// dpal 'brug pa yab sras thugs rje'i gter// 'bangs blo sna tshogs 'gyur bar mdzod// phyi 'dod yon gyi snang ba bkrag che yang*// nang blo gros kyis gzhig na rtag mi thub// don mdo med cig la ma skyel bar// nges 'byung skyo shas skyed cig he ru ka

/phyi gnas bskor gyi mthong rgya tsam che yang*// nang rang sems 'thul bar ma gyur na// don lha chos kyi dgos pa stor ba'i phyir// dben gnas ri khrod 'grims shig he ru ka /phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa tsam rdzig kyang*// nang zhen log gis 'khri ba ma chod na// don thar ba'i rgyal sa mi snyogs pas// bzang rdzu'i spyod pa bor dang he ru ka /phyi he ru ka dpal gyi cha byad kyang*// nang brtul zhugs kyi dar dang mi ldan na// don gsang chen gyi spyod par mi 'gro bas// tho co'i rtsa di hral spongs shig he ru ka /phyi pho nya'i lam gyis rtsal yongs yang*// nang 'dzag bde'i rgyu lam ma khegs na// don dga' bzhi'i pha mthar mi son pas// phyag rgya'i 'khri ba chod cig he ru ka /phyi rtsa rlung gi rtsab rtsub ci byas kyang*// nang dpyid kyi thig le 'di ma 'bar na// don lus kyi rtsa mdud mi khrol bas// gdan sa pa'i gnad ka gzung zhig he ru ka /phyi smra tshod kyi lta ba tsam bzang yang*// nang gzung 'dzin gyi mgo bo mchog na// don yin lugs kyi sgro 'dogs mi chod pas// da kha nang du ltos shig he ru ka /phyi zab zab kyi sgom tshul ci mang yang*// nang bcos min gyi gdengs tshad ma rnyed na// don gnas lugs kyi rang ngo mi mthong bas// sems bcas bcos spongs shig he ru ka /phyi lta tshul la sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas kyang*// nang stong nyid kyi khyer (29ba58)sos ma zin na// don mthar thug gi sa lam 'di mi bgrod pas// kha dang zhe phugs bstun zhig he ru ka /phyi gzhan snang gi 'gro don rgya che yang*// nang rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ma zad na// don bdag gzhan gyi phan bde mi 'grub pas// da rang 'dod spongs shig he ru ka /'di yang gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba mdo sngags ras chen khrag 'thung kun dga' dpal zhes pa'i slob bu la/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i 'dun sa tsa ri trar gdams pa'o/// /yul pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir// chos mkhas par rlom pa grangs mang yang*// don yin lugs mdzub tshugs ston pa de// mtshan snyan par grags pa'i ra lung pa// dpal ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po tsam// pha dus gsum rgyal ba'i gar pu der// tshe 'di phyi kun gyi skyabs gtad nas// khyod kha tsam min par gsol ba thob// mchog thun mong zer ba'i sgra bo che// 'bad med du 'byung bar the mi tshom// bsgom bya dang sgom byed sgom pa gsum// yin lugs la sgrib pa'i zol sbyor te// rnam rtog gi dgra bos srid du bkug

/bcos ma'i gya gyur chags kyang ci// sems ma bcos ji bzhin bzhag pa la// gnyen po'i lhan pa mi gdab ma// 'di dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam yin// chos kun gyi rang zhal yengs med bltas// bying rgod kyi mtshan ma de khar zhig /spang gnyen mnyam nyid kyi ngang du 'byams// dus rtags la ma ltos rgyal sa snyogs// rjes shes la snying rje'i rang nyams 'char// sgyu ma la sgyu ma'i mkhan pos bzhin// sdig sbyong dge sgrub la lag len gyis// tshig de skad bka' brgyud bla ma'i bu// ming yongs su grags pa'i pad dkar gyis// khyod byas pa can gyis dris pa'i lan// tshig sgra tshad kyis gzhal na nges shes skye// don gsung rab la gtugs pas nying khur mthong*// (30na59)zhes pa skyid zhod nas sde pa a bsod pas zhus pa la gnang ba'o/// /'phan po rab 'byams pa chos grub dpal bzang bcud len la brten nas lo bdun byang sen mo dor sgrub pa la bzhugs/ skabs zhig bya yul gyi gzhis kha chos rgyal lhun rtser mjal ba la khor cig yongs pa la gnang ba/ dben gnas ri khrod 'grim pa na/ ched gnyer gyi ri khrod 'grim pa na// ched gnyer gyis kha zas mi bsgrub cing*// sdug sgur gyis lus chud mi gsan par// gang byung la brten na legs par go// sems mi rtog ngang du 'byams pa'i dus// ltogs skom gyi snang ba gang yang med// ming snyan po ting 'dzin gyi kha zas zer// khyod sgo gsum bsrangs su bcug pa na// lus dal yang sems kho rgyu 'grul mang*// de bsgom chen bub pa'i sa cig yin// blo mde'u rtse nang du gtad nas su// skad cig ma rer yang yangs ma 'jug /bsam med kyi ngang du las med par// mnyam gzhag la ji tsam gzhag sdong pa// de nas zad par sogs yang yang bslab// mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ci dga' 'byung*// zhe 'dod kyi khong skran ma zhugs shing*// yon tan la dga' rlom ma skyel bas// snying rus kyis sgom pa mthar phyung ba// bka' brgyud kyi bla ma'i grwa sar chug

/shākya thub kyi bstan pa'i srol kha zin// thabs mkhas kyi 'gro don 'grub ste 'ong*// mi nga zer bden nam rdzun pa ste// ci zer de lag tu blangs na gsal// rgyus med kyi rgyus gtam bshad mkhan min// blo 'chug med kyi gdengs tshang bkal bas chog /ces so/// /rje btsun 'brug pa 'di bla mar bzang na bsten// mos gus ltem brkyang 'di zhe nas 'dzangs nas bskyur// byin rlabs chen po 'di gnang nga la mkhas pas byung*// ci gsung dang bka' sgrub 'di zhu ba la shes pas byung*// gnang mkhas dang zhu shes 'di (30ba60)snang ba bde bas byung*// sems nyid bde bas byung*// gcig shes kun grol 'di yid smon shor rar byung*// kun shes gcig rdugs la zhe nas khrel bas bskyur// pad+ma dkar po 'di 'chad pa la mkhas par song*// dad ldan bu slob tsho nyan pa shes pas chog /'chad shes dang nyan shes 'di snang ba bde bas byung*// sems nyid bde bas byung*// lho phyogs rgyal khams 'di dus khams bde bas gzung*// sgom 'dris dred po la zhe nas 'dzangs pas gzung*// su dgos phan 'dogs 'di chos pa'i rnam thar yin// byas shes drin bzo 'di mi lugs legs par grag /phan 'dogs dang drin gzo 'di snang ba bde bas byung*// sems nyid bde bas byung*// sgrub 'dod gsha' ma gcig snying gi khong nas langs// rnam g.yengs bshol 'debs shig ga nas 'ong snyam dred// gong ma'i gshegs bshul bros dus sleb pa na/ khams gsum 'khor ba la rgyang por ran pa no// bros dus dang por dus 'di snang ba bde bas byung*// sems nyid bde bas byung*// zhes pa dmag sde gdags phu dgon gsar du'o/// /'di kha shed gsang sngags rdo rje'i gling*// rje mthu stobs zhabs kyi gdan sa'i mthal// khyab bdag rang byon gyi dga' tshal na// nyams spro ba'i ngang du yal la la// blo bde ba'i rgyang glu rtse re re// phu yid 'ong brag ri mthon po'i rtser// g.ya' spang gi smin 'khyug brjid chags pa// sprin smug po'i 'khor sa gzigs mor che// bya ri dgas rtsed 'jo yid la 'bab// tshe blos btang mdzad pa'i bzhugs sar gda'// bar tsan dan nags ma sman gyi ljongs// gtsug lag khang khang pa phran gyis bskor// chos byed kyi 'du long de ru byed// tshe don ldan gyi skal ba dge sa 'dir// thos bsam zhig mdzad na da lta byon// mda' dad ldan sbyin bdag 'du ba'i grong*// de 'byor (31na61)zhing rgyas pa mi yis gang*// khong gdong dmar bod dang kha khwa'i zong*// ci 'dod kyi 'grim sa de na mchis// phyug po zhig mdzad na de tshor song*// rang gang 'dod yod pa'i 'du sa 'di// sum rtsen gyi gnas lhag yin nam snyam/

zhes rdo rje gling gi gnas bstod phyag mdzod bsod rgyam pa'i ngor blangs pa'o/// /bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag tshul bzhin du// sgom pa 'di nyid tshogs gsog rab yin gyi// dus rnams kun tu 'bad pa chen po yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i go cha gyon// zab khrid mang po'i thos lo gsogs pa las// snying la gang phan gcig la phur btsugs nas// nyin mtshan le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// thos bsam sgom pa'i snying po blang bar gyis// rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims pa'i ldom bu bas// chags med stan thogs gcig tu 'dug tshugs pa// 'dun ma'i spyod khams che bar nges pas su// ma gcig tshe dang bsgrub pa e snyoms ltos// sems 'dzin dmigs pa mang po'i spro bsdu bas// ma yengs dran pas rtse gcig bzhur ba 'di// sgom thabs zab shos yin no rnam kun tu// skad cig nyid la yengs sam bya ra gyis// yi dam lha la bsnyen bsgrub bya ba las// gcig chog bla ma yin par shes nas su// gsol 'debs kho nas nam gzhag 'da' ba 'di// lam gyi sa chod che'o rab 'byams pa// zhes pa lho brag rgyal rtse spang du bya rgod gshong ba'i rab 'byams pa chos 'phel bzang po la gdams pa'o/// /rgyal byed tshal du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas brgyad glur blangs pa// yab bka' rgyud bla ma'i gces phrug nga*// yum gnas gsum mkha' 'gros skyong bzhin pa// snang nyams la do gal mi che yang*// 'phral mtshar ba'i rmi ltas dbyangs su then// shar skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kong (31ba62)po'i mthil// gnas khu chu gsang ba'i nags khrod der// mgon 'khor lo sdom pa bsnyen pa'i tshe// 'od mthon mthing spyi bor zhugs pa'i mod// zil mtshungs pa med de brgyal ba tsam// lus in+d+ra nī la'i bcag 'phro 'dra// der g.yon gyi phyogs nas bar chad bgegs// rlung dmar po 'tshubs kyin don pa rmis// gangs dben pa'i ri bo spos dad ldan// rang byung gi 'phags pa bzhugs pa'i sar// yid bsgoms kyang mi shes sgyu ma'i lus// lha rig 'dzin drag po rtsal du shar// ri rta gdong 'bar dra'i byin chags mdun/
