khong lha srin dam bca' len pa rmis// ma grub pa'i rgyal mos lung bstan pa// ljongs rdo bod mtshams kyi byes 'gol du// mig ngom pa med pa'i na chung gnyis// g.yas g.yon nas bsten pa'i ras chung pa// mdzes sdug gi phul phyin gzhon nu'i tshul// ras dri med dkar ba'i na bza' can// 'dzum bzhin du byin gyis rlobs pa rmis// dpal bkra shis mthong smon chos grwa der// pha bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhal snga nas// zhing mngon dga' rgyal ba'i sras kyi gtso// mtshan pa la glang spos kyi glang po zhes// sku sngo bsangs 'dren byed bdud rtsi'i bcud// sa skyed mos tshal gyi gzhal med du// mtshams lha bus sbyar te mjal ba rmis// yul ḍā ki'i 'dun sa tsa mi tsha ri/ ri ma rgad zhun mas byugs 'dra'i spor/ mtsho zla ba ltar dkar che ba'i mkhar// mi g.yo mgon sprin phung 'khrigs 'dra ba// shar nyin byed shar ba'i 'od zer bcas// byin mtshungs pa med pa'i zil 'od kyis/ mi kho bo'i snying mun bsal ba rmis// gtsang g.yang chags nyang lung bar gyi khul// mi chos smra'i 'dun sa rgyal byed tshal// nub phyogs kyi dgung sngon mthon po'i dbus// 'ja' 'od kyi chu 'dzin 'dzum pa'i bar// 'jam pa'i dbyangs lho la chos 'chad pa/ phun (32na63)sum du tshogs pa'i bkod pa rmis// lho mkho mthing gter gyi lha khang du// thad snyoms pa lag mthil 'dra ba'i dbus// ri phag pa 'dra ba smug po'i brag /dpal ding ri glang 'khor yin snyam par// pha dam pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// lam sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa la// cer mthong gi bka' babs gtad pa rmis// mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba dud gi brag /sems nyams dga'i nor bu spungs ba'i nang*// g.ya' dag gi me long gtsang ma der// khong dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pa// mtshan snyan po mar pa lo tsa byon// rgyud brtag gnyis rdzogs par nyan pa rmis// zhes so/// /der rmi lam brda bzhi mgur du blangs pa/

shar gsang yul ne tsu la yi tshal// rgyal chen gyi pho brang nyams dga' bar// mdun bzhugs kyi mchog gsum kho bo skyong*// ltas ngo mtshar ma 'ongs lung ston brda// lho de wi ko ṭi'i brag steng du// pha rje btsun sku gdung zos kyin 'phel// mthar sa gzhi thams cad 'phyur gyis khyab// ltas ngo mtshar ma 'ongs lung ston brda'// nub spos skya'i yang dben g.ya' spangs mtshams// bka' 'gyur ro'i glegs bam zin snyam par// kun gcig la gcig tha mi rngar gyur brdungs// ltas ya mtshan ma 'ongs lung ston brda'// byang zab yang dbu rtse chen po'i 'dab// rje 'jam mgon phyag gi ral gri rnyed// de g.yugs pas nags tshal dum bur bcad// ltas ya mtshan ma 'ongs lung ston brda// ces so/// /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson */ 'gro drug mnar ba 'di bsam kyin// chos snying nas byed pa'i go cha yis// rigs drug la thar pa'i go 'phang sbyin// pha mtshan ldan gyi byin rlabs ma zhugs na// don rgya chen gyi gzhan dga' mi byung bas// dus rgyun chad med par mos gus gyis// gsol 'debs la (32ba64)brtson pa cis kyang legs// rang rgyud la su phan dge ba'i bshes// phyogs 'dzin gyi gdon gyis ma bslang bar// phyogs med la bla mar mthong gyur na// snang srid kun bla mar 'gyur nges yin// gcig shes kun grol gcig cis mi yong*// zhes rdza sna gdan sa tshul khrims seng ge la 'brog ri bo brag tu gdams pa'o/// /chos sngar byas kyi don kun sgrub pa'i mi// nyams rtogs kyi yon tan 'bar bas na// dngos 'dzin gyi rtog par bsnyon thangs mkhan// phyag chen rgyal khams 'grim pa yi// mi khyed dang sngon nas 'brel ba'i bshes// ming yongs su grags pa'i pad+ma dkar// gzhan phan du bsnyad pa'i rnam g.yeng gis// kun rdzob kyi glong du 'khyams pa lags// bden gnyis la tha dad ma phyed pas// blo chen po'i ngo na bsam gtan la// de bden rdzun grub thob khyod kyis ltos// mi gzhan ngor tshig 'di snyad ka'i gzhi// rang dpon slob gnyis la brjod bral yin// zhes ri bo brag nas rdza sna bla ma kun spangs pa la springs pa'o/// /de yang tsa ri stag du nam byi gung thun la gnas mnyam du bskor ba'i gseb na ngo mtshar gyi rten 'brel kho bos 'grig pa shel gong mdun du mnyam par gnas kyang rdo rje karma babs pa la de nyid du cir yang 'char la gzhan mig skyon med pa'i yul kyis brgyal kyang shes rjen ce re ba ltar du nges nas 'di bgyis so// gnas byin rlabs su che'o mkha' spyod gyi tsa ri// rgyud gnyan po kun nas gnas mchog tu gsungs pa// gnas byin rlabs su che bsam ngag dbang gi nor bu// sems dad pa la brten nas bskor ba la chas so// lus ngal dub tu gyur kyang khu 'khrig 'dra med pas// sngon grub thob kyis byon pa'i bshul rjes su bsnyegs pa// phyi ri mtsho shing gsum de tsam zhig min pa// nang sprul pa'i lha zhal ris med du (33na65)shar bas/

mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'bad med du rnyed nas// yul snang dang rang sems gnyis med du 'dres pa// rje khong tsho dang mnyam pa'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas tsam// mi nga la yong ba'i re go yang ce mchis// gnas lhan cig tu 'khor snyam yus po'i gseb na// ma mkha' 'gros gzigs pa kho bo la byung bas// rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad rang sar zhi nas// nyams ngo mtshar gyi mtshan ma du ma'i 'char sgo// 'phral dgos 'dod kyi rten 'brel yid bzhin du 'grig byung*// phyi snang ba'i rkyen la khyad par med kyang*// rang mos pa'i rjes 'gro mig can mdun du// shel gong sogs rkyen zhig khyad med du bkod kyang*// pra babs kyi na chung gcig pus mthong ltar// nga rang snang la yid ches dga' yo skyid do// gnas tsa ri 'khor bsam nyams dga' blo bde// don 'chugs med 'grub pas 'bol le shig shig /da gang byas bde ba'i gu yangs la bsleb bo// ces so/// /yul dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su// lha zhing skyong ḍā ki bsu mar bsleb// ma 'gro drug sgrol ba'i rten 'brel zhig /dpal tsa ri tra ru sgrigs shig lo// 'dir snang la do gal ma byas pas// gnas ḍā ki'i pho brang chen por bsleb// mgon rdo rje btsun mo'i lha khang bgyis// der gnas gsum mkha' 'gro glu gar mdzad// de mthong thos bsam gtan bde bar reg /e ma ho skal ba bzang ngo snyam// dpal rdo ba'i snying phug chen por bsgom// khong zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i gral khyur tshud// tshogs ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas myong*// longs spyod mi 'byung gi don ma mchis// sang de nas sgrol ma'i bla ri brgal// mgon nag po chen po bzhugs pa'i rong*// bya rog gdong gtam snyan dbyangs su gyer// dgra gnya' rengs yan bar mi 'chor gsung*// sa de nas la gsum brgal ba'i (33ba66)phug /ma rdo rje phag mo'i mtshan snyan du// phyogs shar nas dkar gsal zla shar tshe// mi kho bo 'dug pa'i brag steng nas// rdzas nor bu chu shel 'dzag pa'i chu// gos dmar steng 'khyil ba myangs kyin zhim// de nas rkyen med kyi sgra chen grag

/sang rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten mthong*// gsar byung gi bdud rtsi skom du bsten// der sa gzhi 'dar zhing ri bo 'khrol// bar chad dngos grub 'thab pa phyi ma rgyal// mi 'jigs pa'i seng ge'i khri chen rnyed// mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba'i rgyal sgo mthong*// lha rnams rgyal thugs kyi 'od zer lnga// mi kho bo'i snying gar thal gyis zug /lam dka' yang bsdos te phyin pas 'tshangs// 'od 'bar du dgos 'dod kyi rten 'brel 'grig /g.yu mtshor bgegs tshogs kyi babs zhus longs// stag tshang du mngon spod kyi las par bskos// nyams 'phral snang gi 'char sgo bshad mi rdzogs// dus ma 'ongs ston pa 'di ka tsam// khyed grogs la dga' nas blangs pa yin// mi kun la mi bsgrags gsang bar 'tshal// gtam bden rdzun lo ras gsal du 'gro// nga dga' yo skyid do thol le rgyal// ces so/// /yul ḍā ki'i pho brang dpal gyi tsa ri// gsang chen gyi dkyil 'khor ris med du 'char ba// de 'dra tsho 'khor ba skal bzang gi me long*// dngos grub len shes 'di 'dun ma'i yang rtse// bsams kyin 'tshengs pa 'di gtan gyi gtan don// dad ldan bskor mi tsho skyid pa'i glu len// gsang chen snod gyur 'dis dga' ba'i bro brdung*// blo bde dang gu yangs su 'bol mo 'dzom 'dzom// dal 'byor gyi mi lus don ldan du sbyar nas// gzhan don gyi snying po byang chub mchog sgrub pa// de 'dra tsho shākya thub bstan 'dzin gyi me long*// lha chos byed shes 'di 'dun ma'i yang rtse// byas pas 'tshengs pa 'di gtan gyi gtan don// dad ldan mched lcam tsho skyid pa'i glu len// sangs rgyas (34na67)sar chas 'dis dga' ba'i bro brdung*// thar pa dang rnam grol du 'bol mo 'dzom 'dzom// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma tshul bzhin du bsten nas// thos bsam gyi mthar thug sgrub pa la sbyar ba// de 'dra tsho bya btang tshogs ba'i me long*// pha rjes snyog shes 'di 'dun ma'i yang rtse// blo rtse gcig 'dril 'di gtan gyi gtan don// sgom chen gral ring tsho skyid pa'i glu len// chags zhen med pa 'dis dga' ba'i bro brdung*// 'og min gnas mchog tu 'bol mo 'dzom 'dzom// zhes pa 'di yang shar me rag mdo pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang*// bsod nams 'brug rgyal gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor pad+ma dkar pos sbyor ba'o/// /ma 'gro drug gi don du rab dmigs nas// pha mtshan ldan gyi bla mar blo gtad de// sems bcos min gyi ngang du mnyam par zhog

/tshogs drug gi snang ba mi dgag la// gsar skyes kyi rtog pa'i rang ngo blta// chu thog tu chu rgyun blug pa bzhin// rkyen rang grol gyi nyams len blo bde po// bogs rlung rtsol gyis bton na gsal nyams che// yid mi rtog pa'i ngang du 'byams klas na// rang ci 'dod kyi mngon shes rdzu 'phrul 'grub// de myur lam gsol 'debs kyi zab mo yin// thun mjug tu dge ba gzhan don bsngos// thun mtshams su gtor mchos spyod rem// bden gnyis zung 'brel gyi lam chen po// sangs rgyas su 'gro ba'i stags ka yin// nor yod dgu dge sbyor gyi bya btang khyod// gnas 'di 'drar bsgom pa skal ba bzang*// tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du// 'bral med kyi smon lam kho bos 'debs// zhes stang rtsa dge slong kun dga' dbang phyug tsa ri trar lo mtshams kyi bcad rgyar gnas pa'i bya dgar pad+ma dkar pos gdams pa'o/// /lto gos gtam gsum la rtsi gzhag bsgyur ba no// (34ba68)'jig rten chos brgyad la theg brdzis byed pa no// tshe 'di blos gtang la nyams len byed pa no// chos rje rgya ras kyi rnam thar slob pa no// lo rgod rnam gnyis kyi srol la 'jug pa no// pha rjes bus gseb kyi go cha gyon pa no// ri khrod dben dang la pha yul byed pa no// zhen log snying rus la pa nor byed pa no// snying rje dang mos gus la grogs po 'chol ba no// stong nyid zab mo la rten phur 'dzugs pa no// chags snang rmongs gsum la ro snyoms byed pa no// rang don yid byed la dgra ru lta ba no// sems can kun don la lag len byed pa no// zhes pa mtsho yul pad+ma gling du'o/// /lha bzang po dkon mchog rin chen gsum// mtshan snyan po bshad na 'brug pa'i rje// pha de la dad pa'i gsol 'debs mkhan// nged rnal 'byor gyi byung tshul 'di ltar yin// yul grags pa can gyi kong por skyes// thog med kyi rigs bdag bla mar bsten// lo gsum gyi ngo na chos dang mjal// sngar sbyangs kyi las 'phro yin lugs sad// rigs rgyud dang skyes sa mi drag kyang*// mi chen gyi khrod du 'bad med tshud// 'bangs chab srid bod yul su cher do// che btsun gyi blo gtad bshad mi rdzogs// tshe 'di kas 'thus na de kas 'ong*// rig gnas kun ma bslabs khong du chud// yi dam gyi byin rlabs ngo mtshar che// dus da lta dbus gtsang dag pa'i ljongs// su mkhas kyi tshogs su rtsod kyin du// mi kho bo'i shes par 'gran mkhan med// mthos dogs kyi zug rngu ldang ba mang*// gzur gnas kyis smra ba'i dbang por bsngags// chos shes rgyu'i sbag sbug byed ma dgos// chos bshad la 'gran med cis mi 'ong*// sdom gsum gyi nom pa tshul bzhin blangs// gzhan phan gyi ched du sgo gsum bkol// rang don gyi gnyer kha rgyang du brims// gnod byas kyi lan du bde ba spro// (35na69)sman lan du dug 'jal la mi khro// phrag dog gis gzhan legs dgag ma myong*// rang rgyud la nyon mongs yan mi gtong*// kha 'jam gting rtsub la khyad gsad byas// tsher ma dar bstums dang cung mi 'dra// mi tshe rab cig 'dra des phyir mod// nga de kun gyis blo kha ma rdzogs nas// rje ras chen 'dra ba'i chos cig bsams// 'jig rten chos brgyad la rngog brdzis byed// snying nas kyi thar pa sgrub la 'gro// mi nged kyi rjes su 'jug pa dka'// khyed lha yi sras mo dad pa can// blo rtse gcig mtshan ldan bla mar gtod// las mi dge bcu la mdzes pa dang*// dkar po dge ba brtson pas bsgrubs// 'di phyi bar gsum du legs pa'i thabs// zhes spel byung nas a che bsod nams dbang mos bskul ba'i ngor pad+ma dkar pos mkho mthing lha khang chen por bris pa dge// thub bstan lang tsho bdo ba'i thang byams pa chen po'i chos kyi gling dang khang nye ba'i ljon shing gi gseb tu gnas pa'i nub gcig rmi lam du// gnas brtan mkhas par rlom pa'i btsun pa rgan seb pa zhwa can zhig na re// khyod mdo rgyud sde rab 'byams la sbyangs pa ma byas par shod mi 'os// chos la brgyud pa// de yang thos bsam byas pa bar ma chad pa dgos pa yin// gzhan mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'od zer ba'i lan 'di skad btab pa rmis so// rje na mo// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas skad grags can// mtshan ldan gyi slob dpon 'di khar 'dug

/de phyir brgyud brgyud kyi nye ring bzhag /blo bla mar bkal ba nged kyi lugs// pha rdo rje 'chang chen ngag gi dbang*// 'khor mang po 'dus pa'i tshogs dbus su// mi kho bo'i snying la phyag mdzub gtad// bslab sbyang gi ngal ba bya mi dgos// chos kun shes 'di nas rang brdol 'ong*// lhag par gzhan don gshegs ka'i dus// (35ba70)mi khyod dang chos skyong phyag bzhi par// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i khur bab gsung*// de snying la ma brjed bris pa'i phyir// dus da lta chags sdang gi tsher dong bu// zung rngu la ma 'dzem bstan pa spel// mi bdag gi lag pa'i snyim pa zung*// pha rje btsun phyag gis bcangs bcangs nas// steng 'og dang phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du// bstan pa dar zhing du rgyas pa'i rgyud// khyod nyid gyur cig gi smon lam mdzad// bden stobs kyi phul 'dis phyogs dus gar// mi kho bo'i 'phrin las nub mi snyam// gzhan du yang rje btsun btsun mo can// dpal a wa dhū ti'i zhal snga nas// snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag ci 'phrod mdzad// lag khrid kyi 'phrang la brdar nas zhus// phyogs 'di la rmongs pa yid ches phyir// bka' thob dang lung thob tsam gyis chog /mngal gnas kyi dra mi myur du byang*// tshig re la zab rgyas kyi gter 'don nges// mched lcam dral 'dus pa'i dbus su gsung*// rje rdo rje gling pa mthu stobs zhabs// ji snyed kyi dpe kun lag gtad nas// khyed nā ro chos kyi spyan ldan yin/ chos kun gyi rdo rje slob dpon 'os// khyad par du dud sol lha mo la// nga phyin chad da phyir mi dgos kyi// mi 'di yi lus dang grib mar 'grogs// ci bco ba'i las ka bgyi zhes gdams// de bden pa'i dpang du mched grogs mang*// pha grub thob gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs// lung bstan dang rjes su gnang ba thob// khong phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byon lags kyang*// don de bas lhag pa yod snyam med// tshe 'di la rnam par g.yeng ba'i ngang*// mi gzhan ma bya bya sbyang ma khom// 'on kyang du shes bya rig pa'i gnas// phal cher la ma rmongs mkhas par grags// dus da lta sde snod 'dzin pa'i khrod// mi kho bo'i do ya non mkhan med// nga de phyir shes nas 'chad pa yin// gnang ba thob nas rtsoms pa yin// log smra 'dug nas rtsod (36na71)pa yin// 'di bsams kyin rje btsun lung bstan dran// dran gyin du gdung shugs je cher thal// zhes nam seng phral zin bris su byas so/// /dpal gang gi zhabs skyes 'khor lo zung*// su dad pas thod bzhin bsten pa de// dgra mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i// mgon rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gral khyur 'dzud// da de phyir dad pas gsol ba 'debs// khyod nyon dang chos mdzad sgrub pa po// blo rtse gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub zer na// ma khams gsum 'gro la snying rje'i blos// tshe 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon bla mar zhus// dus rgyun chad med pa'i gsol ba thob// chos kun gyi gnas lugs ji lta ba// rang sems las gzhan du mi rnyed pas// sems ji bzhin bzhag pa sgom pa'i lam// phyis gnyen pos bcos slad mi gzhug par// gang shar gyi steng du rgya yan glod// mnyam nyid kyi glong du 'byams par mchis// ma bcos lhun grub kyis 'bras bu 'byung*// pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i gsang tshig yin// khong ku sa li pa'i sman sbyor te// bka' mdo rgyud kun gyi zhe phugs lags// zhes rong lung bstan dgon pa dpon slob rnams kyis zhus pa la'o/// /rje bla ma'i sgrub gnas rong ri 'thul du gnas 'brel tsam bgyis pa'i nub// btsun pa chen po gcig gis byang drangs khrom tshad med pa zhig kho bo la dga' ba'i lugs kyis bsnyen bkur 'phros pa sna tshogs gtam du bgyid pa'i rmi lam cung zad gsal btab pa/

khyod 'dir tshogs lta 'dre gros byas nas/ mtho 'tsham dmag gi bskor lags kyang*// pha chos nyid bden pa gzigs pa des// blo bde ba'i rtsal du khyer bas su// bar chad bdud kyi skabs ma phye// der ya mtshan khyed kyis mtshan gsos pa// dpal sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rin po che// khyed thams cad bka' yi 'bangs su bgyis// de mi tra dza gi'i (36ba72)thugs rje'i rlabs// mi kho bo'i snying la gsos su brlan// blo pad+ma dkar po'i 'dab brgya phye// chos legs bshad dri bzang khungs su song*// mgon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdan du phul// khong blo gsal snying ga sim mod kyang*// nyams bdud rtsi'i zil dngar rgyas pa'i phyir// sa 'dir yang bag phebs grogs su bsnyen// de lha mi tshogs pa'i dga' ston yin// rje dam pa'i bka' btags rjes dgongs la// gnas 'dir bsgom 'gal rkyen mi 'byung bar// yid mthun pa'i don kun grub par mdzod// ces smras so/// /de la gnas bstod du bgyis pa// rje na mo// steng brag dmar zur gsum rtse ma thob// de sngon mo gnam gyi grogs 'os snyam// mtshams chu 'dzin 'thug pos sbyar ba yis// gtam snyan pa 'brug gis ches cher sgrog /nyams dga' pa'i rol pa glog gi rtses// sgra 'ur 'ur gnam lcags thog gis sbyor// yid sem pa zla shel khu bas skyed// de ngo mtshar lha yi skyed mos tshal// bar g.ya' sdang 'thab pa 'ja' tshon 'dra// nad brgya rtsa 'joms pa'i sman kun 'khrungs// bya yid 'od dus kyi sgra snyan bsgyur// chu dngas mo rdzing du 'khyil ba can// ri g.yas g.yon spang po ngos gzar ba// dbyar mthon kha'i ne gsing brdal ba la// blo spro ba'i me tog tshal du chags// khong bung ba glu len lding ba'i khrod// lha gnyan po kun gyi rtsed 'jo rtsom// sman mtshar mo'i dor gzigs mor che// sa de 'dra'i skyibs na bsam gtan khang*// pha nam mkha' rdo rje'i grong bzhugs pa// gnas rdo rje'i gdan dang mtshungs pa yod/

smad brag ri nags tshal dra ba can// gcan gtum po'i ngur sgra skyi sha g.ya'// chu drag po'i hūṃ sgra ba spu ldang*// 'dre lta srin gyi gas sgra zhe rtsa 'jigs// mi skal med kyi srog la hab bsha' yong*// grogs skal ldan gyi tshogs la spa bkong nas// mthar dngos grub ster ba'i gnyen du khugs// (37na73)sa de la mtshan snyan rong ri 'thul// mdun rdo bod mtshams kyi gangs ri rnams// 'phral skyo shas kyi dge bskul che la bdar// rkyen bser bus bying ba sel ba'i dpyid// tshe blos btang gi 'byon sa 'di na gda'// zhes so/// /sdon byon grub thob kyi pad+ma 'byung*// phyis dar pa rje btsun ras chung nas// pha sgyu ma'i gar mkhan yan chod du// skyes chen gyis byin brlabs byar bu'i nags// dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sgrub pa'i gnas// sa der yang rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i 'phrul// nges 'ga' ni mi chen gyi tshogs dbus na// sdig spyod la tsa ra bda' 'ded pa// 'ga' zhig tu rab byung btsun pa'i gseb// lung rigs kyis chos log sun 'byin mkhan// la la na pha rjes bus snyog pa'i// tshe blos btang rnal 'byor brel ba can// brtags na byar med kyi rnal 'byor pa// ma brtags pa'i ngo na las mang po// 'di thams cad gzhan don gyi rtsal sbyong zhes// nyams dga' nas rgya glu 'then lags kyi// khyed blo kha tshim mam dad ldan rnams// dbyangs mchod pa'i rdzas bzhes ḍā ki ma// zhes so/// /byang dam rings kyi chos grwa chen por dge ba'i bshes gnyen slob dpon 'bum rab 'byams pa la bsrings pa// dpal snying po don gyi bstan 'dzin la// rgya gar na grub thob brgyad cu bzhi// bod yul na dgas po bka' brgyud tsam// gzhan tha snyad la sangs rgyas dngos su re// nged bcos min gyi lam pa phyag rgya che// gshis rnam dbyes btang ba'i lhan cig skyes// rang gzhan gyi stong pa sgro btags yin// khyab gdal du 'jog shes cig car ba// sems skye med rim pa'i phyogs la ni// rtse gcig dang spros bral ro gcig dang*// sgom med kyi lhan cig skyes rnam bzhi// mi thod brgal 'jug pa'i lam rim mo// sems shin sbyangs yid byed kyi rang bzhin la// ming rtse gcig pha rgyud (37ba74)pa sems dben zer// sems rnam bcas dmigs pa nyer zhi la// spros bral te mngon par byang chub pa// sngar du mar gzung ba gcig tu 'dres// de ro gcig slob pa'i zung 'jug ste// glo bur gyi brdzus ma thams cad zad// lam gzhir phebs sgom med mi slob pa// de re re chung 'bring chen po'i tshul// nyams myong gi spu ris rim gyis pa// de lta ba gtan la 'bebs tshul yin// lus byed bcings kha sbyor rlung gnad kyis// yul thig les rtsa rnams sbyangs pa'i mthar// dpyid bde ba'i snyoms 'jug la zhugs pas// nyams thun mong khyad par mchog gsum 'char// dpe can gyi sgyu ma kun gyis smra// lta gzugs kyi rol mo gsang sngags pa// mchog rnam pa kun ldan 'di shes pas// de snang rmi bar do'i lam khyer yin// phyi mngon byang mtshon byed don dam pa// sems rtog pa snga phyi'i bar du 'bar// gnyid dus su mngon sum byed 'di'i khyad// 'chi dus su cis kyang rtsal rdzogs lo// skal dman la 'pho ba'i skyes me zhes// 'di sgom pa lam gyi khyer so yin// sngon 'gro la mi mthun byung na dga'// dngos gzhi stong nyid ma bcos pa// rnam rtog dang nyon mongs lta 'dre dang*// sdug bsngal dang na tsha 'chi ba sogs// ri mnyam du khyer ba spyod pa yin// tshig cha tsam 'bum phrag gzhung 'dzin pa// chos bshad pas go ba de la gdams// zhes so/// /gcig shes kun grol gyi bla ma// snying ga'i thig le la bzhugs pas// mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo// 'dzad med legs bshad kyi gang byung*// ma bcos mnyam gzhag gi dang na// snang grags lha zhal du mthong bas// ci byed gzhan don du gyur nas/

'phrin las phyogs med du ldan song*// sems g.yeng bar bcad du shes te// yengs med dran pa ru brten pas// bdud rigs chos skyong du 'gyur nas// (38na75)gang bsgo dang len la chas byung*// las 'bras tshul bzhin du go bas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal du shes te// kun 'byung gnyen po la 'bad pas// thar pa gtan 'dun la khugs byung*// zhi bde rang don du shes nas// skad cig de dbang du ma btang*// sgo gsum gzhan phan la bsngos pas// skyid sdug gdam de dang bral song*// snang ba rtsal sbyor la kho nas// sbyin sogs chos spyod la brtson bzhin// zhen pa rang grol du btang bas// 'khor gsum yongs dag tu gyur song*// gang shar rang rig gi longs spyod// snang med gshis lugs kyi babs gnyis// blta bya lta byed du 'dres nas// mnyam nyid khyab gdal du langs song*// mkha' khyab sems can gyi don la// 'bad med sgyu ma yi rol rtsed/ rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi bya gzhag /kha skad ming rkyang du ma lus// ces pa 'di yang bla ma ne'u rings pa chos skyong bde legs 'gro don ji ltar byed 'dri ba na rang lugs kyi 'gro don 'di ltar byed ces gdams pa'o/// /de ltar kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po dgung lo lnga bcu la phebs pa yan gyi rdo rje'i glu ji ltar rnyed pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'dis kyang 'gro ba thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la skal ba bzang po dang ldan par gyur cig// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyid mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
